Based on the search results, here's what I found about the Immich migration from pgvecto.rs to VectorChord:

## Overview

Immich has migrated off of the deprecated pgvecto.rs database extension to its successor, VectorChord, which comes with performance improvements in almost every aspect.(no content)VectorChord is the successor of pgvecto.rs, developed by the same team.

## Key Release Information

Immich version 1.133.0 replaces the deprecated pgvecto.rs extension with its replacement VectorChord.(no content)To ease transition, Immich will support both in parallel for a few releases.(no content)The Immich team is migrating off the deprecated pgvecto.rs database extension to its successor VectorChord, which comes with performance improvements in almost all aspects. This change is a major milestone they want to perform prior to the stable release.

## Benefits of VectorChord

VectorChord is faster, more stable, uses less RAM, and (with the settings Immich uses) offers higher-quality results than pgvector and pgvecto.rs. This translates to better search and facial recognition experiences.

## Migration Process and face_index

Immich will make some changes to the DB during startup, which can take seconds to minutes to finish, depending on hardware and library size. In particular, it's normal for the server logs to be seemingly stuck at Reindexing clip_index and Reindexing face_index for some time if you have over 100k assets in Immich and/or Immich is on a relatively weak server.

## Docker Image Changes

If you are still using the default docker.io/tensorchord/pgvecto-rs:pg14-v0.2.0 image, you can follow the documented changes. For example, if the previous image is docker.io/tensorchord/pgvecto-rs:pg16-v0.3.0, the new image should be ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:16-vectorchord0.3.0-pgvectors0.3.0.(no content)The new DB image includes pgvector and pgvecto.rs in addition to VectorChord, so you can use this image to restore from existing backups that used either of these extensions.

## Important Notes

After switching to VectorChord, you should not downgrade Immich below 1.133.0.(no content)Before making any changes, please back up your database. While every effort has been made to make this migration as smooth as possible, there's always a chance that something can go wrong.

## Version Compatibility

Immich is known to work with Postgres versions >= 14, < 19. VectorChord is known to work with pgvector versions >= 0.7, < 0.9. The Immich server will check the VectorChord version on startup to ensure compatibility, and refuse to start if a compatible version is not found.(no content)VectorChord 0.3.0 is still fully supported. That being said, 0.4.3 has some nice performance improvements so it definitely doesn't hurt going with that.

content.text:
Confirmed - the `face_search` and `smart_search` tables weren't in the backup. This means Immich needs to recreate them and regenerate the embeddings.

Looking at the logs again, Immich is failing because it can't find `face_index` - which is an **index on the face_search table**. We need to let Immich create these tables.

Let me check if there's a way to do this. Looking at the [Immich migration discussion](https://github.com/immich-app/immich/discussions/14640), Immich should auto-create these tables on startup. The error suggests it's trying to query an index before the table exists.

Let me try a different approach - use the pgvecto.rs compatible image first to let Immich migrate properly:

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m
    command:
      [
        'postgres',
        '-c',
        'shared_preload_libraries=vchord.so,vectors.so',
        '-c',
        'search_path="$$user", public, vectors',
        '-c',
        'logging_collector=on',
        '-c',
        'max_wal_size=2GB',
        '-c',
        'shared_buffers=512MB',
        '-c',
        'wal_compression=on',
      ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  model-cache:

Looking at this more carefully - the `face_search` table must have been created by Immich's migrations originally but didn't make it into the pg_dump. This is likely because it uses the `vectors` data type from pgvecto.rs.

Let me manually create the missing tables so Immich can start. According to Immich's schema, we need `smart_search` and `face_search` tables:
Shell escaping issues. Let me try a different approach:

input.command: ssh root@192.168.1.222 "docker exec immich_postgres psql -U postgres -d immich -c \"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS smart_search (\\\"assetId\\\" uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES asset(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, embedding vector(512));\""

Based on your hardware (AMD Radeon 890M), here's the breakdown:

## VAAPI vs ROCm for Your Setup

| Feature | VAAPI | ROCm |
|---------|-------|------|
| **Purpose** | Video transcoding (encoding/decoding) | ML/AI acceleration (face detection, smart search) |
| **Your GPU Support** | ✅ Works on 890M | ❌ Needs ROCm 6.4.4+ (Immich ships 6.3.4) |
| **Container** | immich-server | immich-machine-learning |

**Answer: Use VAAPI for transcoding, CPU for ML**

Your AMD Radeon 890M (RDNA 3.5, gfx1150) is too new for Immich's current ROCm build. According to [GitHub Issue #22874](https://github.com/immich-app/immich/issues/22874), gfx1150 support was only added in ROCm 6.4.4, but Immich's `-rocm` image uses ROCm 6.3.4.

### Current Config is Correct:

- **immich-server**: Has `/dev/dri` for VAAPI transcoding ✅
- **immich-machine-learning**: Using CPU image (no `-rocm` suffix) ✅

### To Enable VAAPI Transcoding:

1. Go to Immich Admin Panel → **Administration** → **Video Transcoding Settings**
2. Set **Hardware Acceleration** to `VAAPI`
3. Set **Hardware Device** to `/dev/dri/renderD128`

### When ROCm Becomes Available:

Once Immich updates their ROCm image to 6.4.4+, you can enable ML acceleration by editing the docker-compose.yml:

```yaml
immich-machine-learning:
  image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:release-rocm  # Add -rocm
  devices:
    - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
  group_add:
    - video
```

Yes, confirmed - it's using `CPUExecutionProvider`. This is expected because:

1. **ROCm won't work** on your Radeon 890M until Immich updates to ROCm 6.4.4+
2. **OpenVINO** is for Intel GPUs only

Your options are:

### Option 1: Accept CPU for ML (Current)
- 95%+ CPU is normal when processing 56k+ photos
- It will finish eventually, just slower
- This is the safest option

### Option 2: Try ROCm Anyway (Experimental)
We could try the ROCm image to see if it works despite the version mismatch. Sometimes it partially works. Want me to try it?

### Option 3: Reduce ML Concurrency
To reduce CPU impact, lower the ML job concurrency in Immich Admin:

1. Go to **Administration** → **Jobs**
2. Find **Smart Search** and **Face Detection** 
3. Set concurrency to **1** (instead of default which may be higher)

This will make it slower but use less CPU at once.

---

**Which would you prefer?** The ML processing will eventually complete on CPU - with 56k assets it might take several hours. You can also pause the jobs from the Admin panel if needed.
no i added more cpu for now, upto 12 instead of 6 so hopefully that helps

Good call - doubling the cores to 12 should help significantly. The ML processing is CPU-bound, so more cores = more parallel processing.

You can monitor progress in the Immich Admin panel under **Administration** → **Jobs**. You'll see:

- **Smart Search** - generates CLIP embeddings for image search
- **Face Detection** - finds faces in photos
- **Facial Recognition** - matches faces to people

With 56k assets, expect it to take a few hours even with 12 cores. The good news is this is a one-time catch-up since the embeddings weren't in your backup - future photos will process quickly as they're uploaded.

Once it settles down, you can scale back to 6 cores if you want to save resources. Just update `var.cores` in [main.tf](tofu/apps/immich/main.tf) and run `task tofu:apply APP=immich`.

Based on my search, here's information about VectorChord's vchordrq CREATE INDEX options and syntax for PostgreSQL:

## VectorChord vchordrq CREATE INDEX Syntax

VectorChord (vchord) is a PostgreSQL extension designed for scalable, high-performance, and disk-efficient vector similarity search.(no content)VectorChord serves as the successor to pgvecto.rs with better stability and performance.

### Basic Syntax

With VectorChord, you can create vchordrq indexes:
```sql
CREATE INDEX ON items USING vchordrq (embedding vector_l2_ops);
```

### Advanced Syntax with Options

Both access methods implement custom index options through PostgreSQL's reloption (relation option) system. This allows users to specify TOML-formatted configuration when creating indexes.

#### Internal Build Options

```sql
CREATE INDEX ON items USING vchordrq (embedding vector_l2_ops) WITH (options = $$
residual_quantization = true
[build.internal]
lists = []
$$);
```(no content)More advanced options example:
```sql
CREATE INDEX ON laion USING vchordrq (embedding vector_l2_ops) WITH (options = $$

The `vectorIndexQuery` function creates VectorChord indices through a SQL CREATE INDEX statement. For the VectorChord case, it generates:

```sql
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ${indexName} ON ${table} USING vchordrq (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (options = $$
residual_quantization = false
[build.internal]
lists = [${lists ?? 1}]
spherical_centroids = true
build_threads = 4
sampling_factor = 1024
$$)
```

- The `lists` parameter (with default value of 1) configures the number of clusters for the index build process
- The `options` parameter contains configuration flags including `residual_quantization`, `spherical_centroids`, `build_threads`, and `sampling_factor`
- If no `lists` value is provided, it defaults to 1 via the nullish coalescing operator (`??`)

The function accepts a `VectorIndexQueryOptions` object containing the table name, vector extension type, index name, and optional lists count.

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# Note: This app imports an existing LXC container rather than creating new.
# Traefik runs as a systemd service (binary install, not Docker).

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "traefik_version" {
  description = "Traefik version to install"
  type        = string
  default     = "v3.2.3"
}

variable "cloudflare_dns_token" {
  description = "Cloudflare API token for DNS challenge (ACME)"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  default     = ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_host" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-host"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Match existing container: ubuntu (not default debian)
  os_type = "ubuntu"

  # Match existing container: nesting enabled
  enable_nesting = true

  # Mount point: host /var/lib/containers/traefik -> container /config
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/config"
      volume = "/var/lib/containers/traefik"
    }
  ]

  template = var.lxc_template

  # Traefik configuration
  traefik_version      = var.traefik_version
  config_dir           = "${path.module}/deploy"
  cloudflare_dns_token = var.cloudflare_dns_token
  domain               = var.domain_internal

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Dashboard Route
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Route configuration is managed in deploy/dynamic/traefik.yml
# The sync_config module in traefik-host syncs this to the container

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    dashboard_direct   = "http://${module.traefik_host.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Traefik", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "Traefik TLS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Dashboard", port = 8080, info = "Traefik API and dashboard (internal only)" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.traefik_host.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Configuration

**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`
**Certificates:** `/config/certs/acme.json`
**Logs:** `/config/logs/`

## Service Management

**Check status:**
```
systemctl status traefik
```

**View logs:**
```
journalctl -u traefik -f
```

**Restart service:**
```
systemctl restart traefik
```

## Certificate Management

Traefik uses Let's Encrypt with Cloudflare DNS challenge.
Certificates are automatically renewed.

**Check certificate status:**
```
cat /config/certs/acme.json | jq '.letsencrypt.Certificates[] | {domain: .domain.main, expiry: .certificate}'
```

## Dynamic Config Updates

Traefik watches `/config/dynamic/` for changes.
New routes are applied automatically without restart.

**Add new route:**
1. Create `/config/dynamic/service-name.yml`
2. Traefik auto-reloads within seconds

## Domain Tiers

- **Internal:** `*.${var.domain_internal}` (local network only)
- **Public:** `*.${var.domain_public}` (via Cloudflare tunnel)
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.traefik_host.ip_address}"
}

output "traefik_version" {
  value = module.traefik_host.traefik_version
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

output "config_sync_command" {
  description = "Command to manually sync config from repo to Traefik"
  value       = "rsync -avz --delete --no-owner --no-group -e 'ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519' ${path.module}/deploy/ root@${module.traefik_host.ip_address}:/config/ && ssh root@${module.traefik_host.ip_address} 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config'"
}

# Traefik - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/

name: traefik

services:
  traefik:
    container_name: traefik
    image: traefik:v3.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
      - "8082:8082"  # Metrics
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
      - CF_API_EMAIL=${CF_API_EMAIL}
    volumes:
      # Static config
      - ./static/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      # Dynamic configs
      - ./dynamic:/config/dynamic:ro
      # Certificates (persisted)
      - certs:/config/certs
      # Logs
      - logs:/config/logs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "traefik", "healthcheck", "--ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=false"

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  certs:
  logs:

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Portainer Agent
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# Include shared variables
# Note: terraform.tfvars is symlinked from parent directory

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for dashboards LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 32
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024  # Match existing container
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = false  # Existing container is privileged
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  template = var.lxc_template

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "docker_host" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  template = var.lxc_template

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # Pass Cloudflare credentials via env_vars
  env_vars = {
    CF_DNS_API_TOKEN = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    CF_API_EMAIL     = "darshanrambhia@live.com"
  }

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container apparmor configuration
  proxmox_ssh_host = var.proxmox_ssh_host
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${module.docker_host.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.docker_host.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f traefik
```

**Restart Traefik:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart traefik
```

**Check certificates:**
```
docker exec traefik cat /config/certs/acme.json | jq '.letsencrypt.Certificates[].domain.main'
```

## Certificate Management

Traefik uses Let's Encrypt with Cloudflare DNS challenge.
Certificates are stored in a Docker volume and persist across restarts.

## Dynamic Config Updates

Traefik watches `/config/dynamic/` for changes.
New routes are applied automatically without restart.

## Domain Tiers

- **Internal:** `*.${var.domain_internal}` (local network only)
- **Public:** `*.${var.domain_public}` (via Cloudflare tunnel)
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.docker_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.docker_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.docker_host.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200 (existing)
# =============================================================================

# Note: This app imports an existing LXC container rather than creating new.
# Traefik runs as a systemd service (binary install, not Docker).

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "traefik_version" {
  description = "Traefik version to install"
  type        = string
  default     = "v3.2.3"
}

variable "cloudflare_dns_token" {
  description = "Cloudflare API token for DNS challenge (ACME)"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  default     = ""
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Host Module
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_host" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-host"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Match existing container: ubuntu (not default debian)
  os_type = "ubuntu"

  # Match existing container: nesting enabled
  enable_nesting = true

  # Mount point: host /var/lib/containers/traefik -> container /config
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/config"
      volume = "/var/lib/containers/traefik"
    }
  ]

  template = var.lxc_template

  # Traefik configuration
  traefik_version      = var.traefik_version
  config_dir           = "${path.module}/deploy"
  cloudflare_dns_token = var.cloudflare_dns_token
  domain               = var.domain_internal

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Dashboard Route
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Route configuration is managed in deploy/dynamic/traefik.yml
# The sync_config module in traefik-host syncs this to the container

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    dashboard_direct   = "http://${module.traefik_host.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Traefik", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "Traefik TLS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Dashboard", port = 8080, info = "Traefik API and dashboard (internal only)" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.traefik_host.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Configuration

**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`
**Certificates:** `/config/certs/acme.json`
**Logs:** `/config/logs/`

## Service Management

**Check status:**
```
systemctl status traefik
```

**View logs:**
```
journalctl -u traefik -f
```

**Restart service:**
```
systemctl restart traefik
```

## Certificate Management

Traefik uses Let's Encrypt with Cloudflare DNS challenge.
Certificates are automatically renewed.

**Check certificate status:**
```
cat /config/certs/acme.json | jq '.letsencrypt.Certificates[] | {domain: .domain.main, expiry: .certificate}'
```

## Dynamic Config Updates

Traefik watches `/config/dynamic/` for changes.
New routes are applied automatically without restart.

**Add new route:**
1. Create `/config/dynamic/service-name.yml`
2. Traefik auto-reloads within seconds

## Domain Tiers

- **Internal:** `*.${var.domain_internal}` (local network only)
- **Public:** `*.${var.domain_public}` (via Cloudflare tunnel)
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik_host.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik_host.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.traefik_host.ip_address}"
}

output "traefik_version" {
  value = module.traefik_host.traefik_version
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

output "config_sync_command" {
  description = "Command to manually sync config from repo to Traefik"
  value       = "rsync -avz --delete --no-owner --no-group -e 'ssh -i ~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519' ${path.module}/deploy/ root@${module.traefik_host.ip_address}:/config/ && ssh root@${module.traefik_host.ip_address} 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config'"
}

## Summary - Traefik Docker Migration

I've updated the Traefik configuration to run as Docker instead of systemd. Here's what changed:

### New Files:
- [docker-compose.yml](tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/docker-compose.yml) - Docker Compose config for Traefik
- [.env.example](tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/.env.example) - Example env file

### Modified Files:
- [main.tf](tofu/apps/traefik/main.tf) - Now uses `docker-host` module instead of `traefik-host`
- [static/traefik.yml](tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/static/traefik.yml) - Added ping endpoint for healthcheck, HTTP→HTTPS redirect

### Benefits of Docker over systemd:
1. **No permission issues** - Docker volumes handle permissions automatically
2. **Persistent certs** - `certs` volume survives container restarts/updates
3. **Easy updates** - Just change image tag and `docker compose pull && up -d`
4. **Consistent with other apps** - Same deployment pattern as Immich, etc.

### Migration Steps:

```bash
# 1. SSH to Traefik LXC
ssh root@192.168.1.162

# 2. Stop systemd service and disable it
systemctl stop traefik
systemctl disable traefik

# 3. Backup existing certs
cp /config/certs/acme.json /root/acme.json.backup

# 4. Apply OpenTofu changes (from local)
task tofu:apply APP=traefik

# 5. Restore certs to Docker volume
docker cp /root/acme.json.backup traefik:/config/certs/acme.json
docker exec traefik chmod 600 /config/certs/acme.json
docker restart traefik
```

# Terraform Provider for Remote Docker Compose Files - Summary

## Provider Usage

The provider enables management of Docker Compose files on remote hosts through SSH connections. Configuration at the provider level establishes defaults for SSH credentials and bastion host settings.

**Key provider arguments include:**
- `ssh_user`, `ssh_key_path` or `ssh_private_key` for authentication
- `ssh_port` (defaults to 22)
- `bastion_host`, `bastion_user`, `bastion_key_path` for multi-hop connections
- `insecure_ignore_host_key` for development environments only

## Resource Definition

The `remote_docker_compose_file_stack` resource manages individual compose deployments with these core arguments:

- `host` - Target system hostname or IP
- `remote_path` - Destination file location on the remote system
- `content` - The compose file data
- `up` - Whether to execute `docker compose up -d` automatically
- `validate` - Whether to run `docker compose config` validation

Resource-level arguments can override provider defaults for SSH and bastion configurations.

## Example Configurations

**Basic deployment:**
```hcl
resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "web" {
  host        = "192.168.1.100"
  remote_path = "/opt/docker-compose/web/docker-compose.yaml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/docker-compose.yaml")
  up          = true
}
```

**With validation and bastion access:**
Configuration includes validation before applying and uses a jump host for reaching internal systems through a single entry point.

## Lifecycle Behavior

- **Create:** Uploads file, optionally validates and starts services
- **Update:** Stops services if running, uploads updated content, restarts if configured
- **Delete:** Stops services and removes the remote file
- **Import:** Existing deployments using format `hostname:path`

# Terraform Provider Filesync: Usage Guide

## Provider Configuration

The provider establishes default SSH settings for all resources:

```hcl
provider "filesync" {
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
}
```

Key provider arguments include SSH credentials (private key, password, or certificate), port settings, and bastion host configuration for jump-host scenarios.

## Core Resources

### filesync_file Resource

Manages individual files on remote hosts. Required arguments are:
- `source`: Local file path
- `destination`: Remote absolute path  
- `host`: Remote host address

Optional parameters control ownership (`owner`, `group`) and permissions (`mode`).

**Basic example:**

```hcl
resource "filesync_file" "nginx_config" {
  source      = "${path.module}/files/nginx.conf"
  destination = "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf"
  host        = "192.168.1.100"
  owner       = "root"
  mode        = "0644"
}
```

### filesync_directory Resource

Synchronizes entire directories with exclusion pattern support:

```hcl
resource "filesync_directory" "configs" {
  source      = "${path.module}/configs"
  destination = "/etc/myapp"
  host        = "192.168.1.100"
  exclude     = ["*.tmp", ".git", "*.bak"]
}
```

This resource "automatically creates destination directory structure" and "removes remote files that no longer exist locally."

## Multi-Host Patterns

Deploy to multiple servers using `for_each`:

```hcl
locals {
  hosts = ["192.168.1.100", "192.168.1.101", "192.168.1.102"]
}

resource "filesync_file" "app_config" {
  for_each    = toset(local.hosts)
  source      = "${path.module}/files/app.conf"
  destination = "/etc/myapp/app.conf"
  host        = each.value
}
```

## Authentication Methods

The provider supports three approaches:
1. **Private key** (default): file path or inline content
2. **Password**: for systems without key access
3. **Certificate**: CA-signed credentials for enhanced security

## Bastion/Jump Host Support

For multi-hop scenarios, configure jump host settings:

```hcl
provider "filesync" {
  bastion_host     = "bastion.example.com"
  bastion_user     = "jumpuser"
  bastion_key_path = "~/.ssh/bastion_key"
}
```

## Drift Detection

The provider implements a two-phase approach: "Plan only checks local hashes; apply validates remote state." During apply, remote file modifications trigger detailed error messages with resolution options.

# =============================================================================
# Filesync Provider Test LXC
# =============================================================================
# Minimal LXC container for testing the terraform-provider-filesync provider.
# This creates a simple Debian container we can SSH into for file sync tests.

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "filesync-test"
  container_id = 999
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Minimal resources
  cores  = 1
  memory = 512
  swap   = 0

  # Storage
  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = 8

  # Network
  network_bridge = "vmbr0"

  # Template
  template = var.lxc_template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key = file(var.ssh_public_key_path)

  # Unprivileged container (simpler, no special config needed)
  unprivileged   = true
  enable_nesting = false

  # Description
  description = "Test container for terraform-provider-filesync"
  tags        = ["test", "filesync"]
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs
# =============================================================================

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# Create the base LXC container with nesting enabled for Docker
module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name           = var.name
  container_id   = var.container_id
  proxmox_node   = var.proxmox_node
  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key

  # Compute
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  # Storage
  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  mount_points   = var.mount_points

  # Network (DHCP only)
  network_bridge = var.network_bridge

  # Template
  template = var.template

  # Features - enable nesting for Docker/Podman
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Device passthrough
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu
  devices    = var.devices

  # Metadata
  description = var.description
  tags        = var.tags

  # Proxmox SSH for privileged container configuration (apparmor)
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path != "" ? var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path : var.ssh_private_key_path
}

# Wait for container to be accessible via SSH (with actual connectivity check)
resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH to become available on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "SSH is ready after $i attempts"
          exit 0
        fi
        echo "Attempt $i/30: SSH not ready, waiting 5s..."
        sleep 5
      done
      echo "ERROR: SSH never became available after 30 attempts (150s)"
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# Install Docker or Podman
resource "null_resource" "install_container_runtime" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
    runtime      = var.container_runtime
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = var.container_runtime == "docker" ? [
      # Install Docker and rsync
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg", # Remove existing key to avoid interactive prompt
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config"
      ] : [
      # Install Podman and rsync
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y podman podman-compose rsync",
      "systemctl enable podman",
      "mkdir -p /config"
    ]
  }
}

# Deploy compose file if provided (single file mode)
resource "null_resource" "deploy_compose" {
  count      = var.compose_file != "" ? 1 : 0
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_container_runtime]

  triggers = {
    compose_hash = fileexists(var.compose_file) ? filemd5(var.compose_file) : "no-file"
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "file" {
    source      = var.compose_file
    destination = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = var.container_runtime == "docker" ? [
      "cd /config && docker compose pull",
      "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
      ] : [
      "cd /config && podman-compose pull",
      "cd /config && podman-compose up -d"
    ]
  }
}

# Sync compose directory using file-sync module
module "sync_compose_dir" {
  source = "../file-sync"
  count  = var.compose_dir != "" ? 1 : 0

  source_dir           = var.compose_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = "/config"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Optional ownership settings
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # Optional file permissions
  file_permissions = var.config_file_permissions

  # Don't start services here - wait for env file to be created
  post_sync_commands = []

  depends_on = [null_resource.install_container_runtime]
}

# Create .env file from env_vars map
resource "null_resource" "create_env_file" {
  count = length(var.env_vars) > 0 ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_container_runtime,
    module.sync_compose_dir
  ]

  triggers = {
    env_hash = sha256(jsonencode(var.env_vars))
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = concat(
      ["cat > /config/.env << 'ENVEOF'"],
      [for k, v in var.env_vars : "${k}=${v}"],
      ["ENVEOF"],
      ["chmod 600 /config/.env"]
    )
  }
}

# Start services after env file is created (or immediately if no env vars)
resource "null_resource" "start_services" {
  count = var.compose_dir != "" || var.compose_file != "" ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_container_runtime,
    module.sync_compose_dir,
    null_resource.create_env_file,
    null_resource.deploy_compose
  ]

  triggers = {
    compose_hash = var.compose_dir != "" ? module.sync_compose_dir[0].content_hash : (
      var.compose_file != "" ? filemd5(var.compose_file) : "none"
    )
    env_hash = length(var.env_vars) > 0 ? sha256(jsonencode(var.env_vars)) : "none"
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = var.container_runtime == "docker" ? [
      # Pull with retry
      <<-EOT
        cd /config
        for i in 1 2 3; do
          echo "docker compose pull attempt $i/3..."
          if docker compose pull; then
            echo "Pull successful"
            break
          fi
          if [ "$i" -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: docker compose pull failed after 3 attempts"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Pull failed, retrying in 10s..."
          sleep 10
        done
      EOT
      ,
      # Up with retry and health check
      <<-EOT
        cd /config
        for i in 1 2 3; do
          echo "docker compose up attempt $i/3..."
          if docker compose up -d; then
            echo "Containers started, waiting 5s for health check..."
            sleep 5
            # Check if any containers exited unexpectedly
            EXITED=$(docker compose ps --status exited -q 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
            if [ "$EXITED" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "All containers running"
              docker compose ps
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "WARNING: $EXITED container(s) exited, checking logs..."
            docker compose logs --tail=20
          fi
          if [ "$i" -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: docker compose up failed after 3 attempts"
            docker compose ps
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Retrying in 10s..."
          sleep 10
        done
      EOT
      ] : [
      "cd /config && podman-compose pull",
      "cd /config && podman-compose up -d"
    ]
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# File Sync Module
# =============================================================================
# Reusable module for syncing files/directories to remote hosts via SSH.
# Handles ownership issues properly by using rsync with --no-owner --no-group
# and optionally setting ownership after sync.
#
# Usage:
#   module "sync_config" {
#     source = "../modules/file-sync"
#
#     source_dir           = "${path.module}/deploy"
#     target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
#     target_path          = "/config"
#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
#
#     # Optional: set ownership after sync
#     owner = "traefik"
#     group = "traefik"
#
#     # Optional: set permissions on specific files
#     file_permissions = {
#       "/config/certs/acme.json" = "600"
#       "/config/.env"            = "600"
#     }
#   }
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# Calculate hash of all files in source directory for change detection
locals {
  # Get all files in source directory
  source_files = var.source_dir != "" ? fileset(var.source_dir, "**") : []

  # Calculate combined hash of all files
  content_hash = var.source_dir != "" && length(local.source_files) > 0 ? sha256(join("", [
    for f in local.source_files : filemd5("${var.source_dir}/${f}")
  ])) : "empty"

  # Build chown command if owner/group specified
  chown_command = var.owner != "" ? (
    var.group != "" ? "chown -R ${var.owner}:${var.group} ${var.target_path}" : "chown -R ${var.owner} ${var.target_path}"
  ) : ""

  # Build chmod commands for specific file permissions
  chmod_commands = [
    for path, mode in var.file_permissions : "chmod ${mode} ${path} 2>/dev/null || true"
  ]

  # Combine post-sync commands
  post_sync_commands = compact(concat(
    [local.chown_command],
    local.chmod_commands,
    var.post_sync_commands
  ))
}

# Sync files to target with retry logic and verification
resource "null_resource" "sync" {
  count = var.source_dir != "" ? 1 : 0

  triggers = {
    content_hash     = local.content_hash
    target_host      = var.target_host
    target_path      = var.target_path
    owner            = var.owner
    group            = var.group
    file_permissions = jsonencode(var.file_permissions)
  }

  # Use rsync with retry logic, checksum verification, and proper error handling
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      set -e

      SSH_OPTS="-i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10"
      MAX_RETRIES=3
      RETRY_DELAY=5

      # Retry loop for rsync
      for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
        echo "rsync attempt $attempt/$MAX_RETRIES..."

        if rsync -avz --checksum ${var.delete_extra ? "--delete" : ""} --no-owner --no-group \
          -e "ssh $SSH_OPTS" \
          ${var.source_dir}/ \
          root@${var.target_host}:${var.target_path}/; then
          echo "rsync completed successfully"
          break
        fi

        if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: rsync failed after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "rsync failed, retrying in $RETRY_DELAY seconds..."
        sleep $RETRY_DELAY
      done

      # Verify sync by checking file count matches
      LOCAL_COUNT=$(find ${var.source_dir} -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      REMOTE_COUNT=$(ssh $SSH_OPTS root@${var.target_host} "find ${var.target_path} -type f | wc -l" | tr -d ' ')

      echo "Verification: Local files=$LOCAL_COUNT, Remote files=$REMOTE_COUNT"

      if [ "$LOCAL_COUNT" != "$REMOTE_COUNT" ]; then
        echo "WARNING: File count mismatch (local=$LOCAL_COUNT, remote=$REMOTE_COUNT)"
        echo "This may be expected if delete_extra=false and remote has additional files"
      fi

      echo "File sync completed and verified"
    EOF
  }
}

# Separate resource for post-sync commands to ensure proper execution
resource "null_resource" "post_sync" {
  count = var.source_dir != "" && length(local.post_sync_commands) > 0 ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [null_resource.sync]

  triggers = {
    sync_id          = null_resource.sync[0].id
    owner            = var.owner
    group            = var.group
    file_permissions = jsonencode(var.file_permissions)
    post_commands    = jsonencode(var.post_sync_commands)
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = var.target_host
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = local.post_sync_commands
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# Architecture:
#   1. LXC container (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Docker runtime installation (null_resource)
#   3. Config files sync (filesync provider)
#   4. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# All resources in ONE state file for atomic updates.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Enable nesting for Docker
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  template = var.lxc_template

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Docker
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_docker" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config/static /config/dynamic /config/certs /config/logs"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Static Config (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_static_config" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/static/traefik.yml"
  destination = "/config/static/traefik.yml"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Dynamic Configs (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_directory" "traefik_dynamic_configs" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/dynamic"
  destination = "/config/dynamic"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file content
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  env_content = <<-EOF
    CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}
    CF_API_EMAIL=darshanrambhia@live.com
  EOF
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync .env file (filesync provider with content)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  # For secrets, we use local_sensitive_file + filesync
  # or generate inline. Using inline content via templatefile approach:
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/.env.example"  # Placeholder, we'll override with content
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0600"
}

# Override .env with actual secrets
resource "null_resource" "create_env_file" {
  depends_on = [filesync_file.traefik_env]

  triggers = {
    env_hash = sha256(local.env_content)
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "cat > /config/.env << 'ENVEOF'",
      "CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}",
      "CF_API_EMAIL=darshanrambhia@live.com",
      "ENVEOF",
      "chmod 600 /config/.env"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack (remotedockercompose provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "traefik" {
  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_docker,
    filesync_file.traefik_static_config,
    filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs,
    null_resource.create_env_file
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f traefik
```

**Restart Traefik:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart traefik
```

**Check certificates:**
```
docker exec traefik cat /config/certs/acme.json | jq '.letsencrypt.Certificates[].domain.main'
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

This deployment uses custom providers:
- `filesync` - Syncs static/dynamic config files
- `remotedockercompose` - Manages Docker Compose stack

Run `task tofu:apply APP=traefik` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

output "filesync_static_hash" {
  description = "Hash of static config for drift detection"
  value       = filesync_file.traefik_static_config.source_hash
}

output "filesync_dynamic_hash" {
  description = "Hash of dynamic configs for drift detection"
  value       = filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs.source_hash
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# Architecture:
#   1. LXC container (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Docker runtime installation (null_resource)
#   3. Config files sync (filesync provider)
#   4. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# All resources in ONE state file for atomic updates.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Enable nesting for Docker
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  template = var.lxc_template

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Docker
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_docker" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config/static /config/dynamic /config/certs /config/logs"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Static Config (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_static_config" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/static/traefik.yml"
  destination = "/config/static/traefik.yml"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Dynamic Configs (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_directory" "traefik_dynamic_configs" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/dynamic"
  destination = "/config/dynamic"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "create_env_file" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  triggers = {
    env_hash = sha256("${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}:darshanrambhia@live.com")
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "cat > /config/.env << 'ENVEOF'",
      "CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}",
      "CF_API_EMAIL=darshanrambhia@live.com",
      "ENVEOF",
      "chmod 600 /config/.env"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack (remotedockercompose provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "traefik" {
  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_docker,
    filesync_file.traefik_static_config,
    filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs,
    null_resource.create_env_file
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`

```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f traefik
```

```

```

```

```

This deployment uses custom providers:
- `filesync` - Syncs static/dynamic config files
- `remotedockercompose` - Manages Docker Compose stack

Run `task tofu:apply APP=traefik` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

output "filesync_static_hash" {
  description = "Hash of static config for drift detection"
  value       = filesync_file.traefik_static_config.source_hash
}

output "filesync_dynamic_hash" {
  description = "Hash of dynamic configs for drift detection"
  value       = filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs.source_hash
}

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Docker
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_docker" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config/static /config/dynamic /config/certs /config/logs"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Static Config (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_static_config" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/static/traefik.yml"
  destination = "/config/static/traefik.yml"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Dynamic Configs (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_directory" "traefik_dynamic_configs" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/dynamic"
  destination = "/config/dynamic"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "create_env_file" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  triggers = {
    env_hash = sha256("${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}:darshanrambhia@live.com")
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "cat > /config/.env << 'ENVEOF'",
      "CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}",
      "CF_API_EMAIL=darshanrambhia@live.com",
      "ENVEOF",
      "chmod 600 /config/.env"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack (remotedockercompose provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "traefik" {
  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_docker,
    filesync_file.traefik_static_config,
    filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs,
    null_resource.create_env_file
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f traefik
```

**Restart Traefik:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart traefik

**Check certificates:**

```

## Managed by OpenTofu

}
