## Summary - New Architecture with Custom Providers

I've refactored Traefik to demonstrate the new unified architecture using your custom providers. Here's what changed:

### Updated Files:

1. **[versions.tf](tofu/versions.tf)** - Added your custom providers:
   - `darshan-rambhia/filesync` - For file/directory sync
   - `darshan-rambhia/remote-docker-compose-file` - For Docker Compose management

2. **[traefik/main.tf](tofu/apps/traefik/main.tf)** - Complete refactor:
   - Uses `lxc-base` module directly (not `docker-host`)
   - Uses `filesync_file` for static config
   - Uses `filesync_directory` for dynamic configs
   - Uses `remote_docker_compose_file_stack` for compose deployment
   - **All in ONE state file**

### New Architecture Pattern:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     app/traefik/main.tf                     │
│                    (Single State File)                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. module "lxc"              → Creates LXC container       │
│  2. null_resource             → Installs Docker             │
│  3. filesync_file             → Syncs static/traefik.yml    │
│  4. filesync_directory        → Syncs dynamic/*.yml         │
│  5. null_resource             → Creates .env with secrets   │
│  6. remote_docker_compose     → Deploys & manages stack     │
│  7. module "proxmox_notes"    → Updates Proxmox UI notes    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Benefits:
- **Single state** - All resources for one app in one place
- **Drift detection** - `filesync` provider tracks file hashes
- **Proper lifecycle** - `remote_docker_compose` handles up/down/update
- **No rsync hacks** - Native provider resources

### Next Steps:
1. Run `task tofu:init APP=traefik` to download new providers
2. The existing container ID 200 will need state import or fresh deploy
3. Apply same pattern to other apps (Immich, dashboards, etc.)

# =============================================================================
# Docker-Ready LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Builds a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker pre-installed.
# This eliminates the need for null_resource Docker installation in OpenTofu.
#
# Build: task packer:build
# =============================================================================

packer {
  required_plugins {
    proxmox = {
      version = ">= 1.2.0"
      source  = "github.com/hashicorp/proxmox"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "proxmox_api_url" {
  type    = string
  default = "https://192.168.1.215:8006/api2/json"
}

variable "proxmox_api_token_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Proxmox API token ID (e.g., root@pam!opentofu)"
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "proxmox_api_token_secret" {
  type        = string
  description = "Proxmox API token secret"
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "proxmox_node" {
  type    = string
  default = "pve"
}

variable "template_name" {
  type    = string
  default = "debian-13-docker"
}

variable "template_description" {
  type    = string
  default = "Debian 13 with Docker CE pre-installed"
}

variable "base_template" {
  type    = string
  default = "local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst"
}

variable "ssh_public_key_path" {
  type    = string
  default = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519.pub"
}

variable "container_id" {
  type        = number
  default     = 9000
  description = "Temporary container ID for building the template"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source: Proxmox LXC Clone
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

source "proxmox-clone" "docker-lxc" {
  proxmox_url              = var.proxmox_api_url
  username                 = var.proxmox_api_token_id
  token                    = var.proxmox_api_token_secret
  node                     = var.proxmox_node
  insecure_skip_tls_verify = true

  # Clone from existing template
  clone_vm = var.base_template

  # Temporary VM settings
  vm_id   = var.container_id
  vm_name = "packer-docker-build"

  # Template output
  template_name        = var.template_name
  template_description = var.template_description

  # SSH connection
  ssh_username         = "root"
  ssh_private_key_file = "~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519"
  ssh_timeout          = "10m"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build {
  sources = ["source.proxmox-clone.docker-lxc"]

  # Install Docker
  provisioner "shell" {
    inline = [
      "echo '=== Installing Docker CE ==='",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync",

      # Setup Docker repository
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",

      # Install Docker
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",

      # Enable Docker service (will start on first boot)
      "systemctl enable docker",

      # Create standard config directory
      "mkdir -p /config",

      # Clean up
      "apt-get clean",
      "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*",

      "echo '=== Docker installation complete ==='"
    ]
  }

  # Clean up for template
  provisioner "shell" {
    inline = [
      "echo '=== Cleaning up for template ==='",

      # Clear machine-id (will be regenerated on first boot)
      "truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id",
      "rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id",

      # Clear SSH host keys (will be regenerated on first boot)
      "rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*",

      # Clear logs
      "find /var/log -type f -delete",
      "truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp",
      "truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog",

      # Clear bash history
      "rm -f /root/.bash_history",
      "history -c",

      "echo '=== Template cleanup complete ==='"
    ]
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Create Docker-Ready LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker CE pre-installed.
# Run this script on the Proxmox host.
#
# Usage: ./create-docker-template.sh
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
TEMPLATE_ID="${TEMPLATE_ID:-9000}"
TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-docker-template}"
BASE_TEMPLATE="${BASE_TEMPLATE:-local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst}"
STORAGE="${STORAGE:-local}"
OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
NODE="${NODE:-pve}"

echo "=== Creating Docker-Ready LXC Template ==="
echo "Template ID: ${TEMPLATE_ID}"
echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

# Check if template ID is already in use
if pct status "${TEMPLATE_ID}" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "Error: Container ID ${TEMPLATE_ID} already exists"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary container
echo ">>> Creating temporary container..."
pct create "${TEMPLATE_ID}" "${BASE_TEMPLATE}" \
    --hostname "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" \
    --storage local-lvm \
    --rootfs local-lvm:8 \
    --memory 2048 \
    --cores 2 \
    --net0 name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=dhcp \
    --features nesting=1,keyctl=1 \
    --start 1

# Wait for container to be ready
echo ">>> Waiting for container to start..."
sleep 10

# Wait for network
echo ">>> Waiting for network..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Network is ready"
        break
    fi
    if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
        echo "Error: Network timeout"
        pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Install Docker
echo ">>> Installing Docker CE..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    echo "Updating packages..."
    apt-get update

    echo "Installing prerequisites..."
    apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync

    echo "Adding Docker repository..."
    install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
    rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list

    echo "Installing Docker..."
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

    echo "Enabling Docker service..."
    systemctl enable docker

    echo "Creating standard directories..."
    mkdir -p /config

    echo "Verifying Docker installation..."
    docker --version
    docker compose version

    echo "Docker installation complete!"
'

# Clean up for template
echo ">>> Cleaning up for template..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    # Stop Docker before cleanup
    systemctl stop docker || true

    # Clear machine-id (regenerated on first boot)
    truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id
    rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

    # Clear SSH host keys (regenerated on first boot)
    rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*

    # Clear logs
    find /var/log -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog 2>/dev/null || true

    # Clear apt cache
    apt-get clean
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    # Clear bash history
    rm -f /root/.bash_history

    # Clear Docker data that should be fresh per container
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/containers/*
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/network/*

    echo "Cleanup complete!"
'

# Stop container
echo ">>> Stopping container..."
pct stop "${TEMPLATE_ID}"

# Create backup (template)
echo ">>> Creating template archive..."
BACKUP_DIR="/var/lib/vz/template/cache"
vzdump "${TEMPLATE_ID}" \
    --compress zstd \
    --mode stop \
    --storage local \
    --dumpdir /tmp

# Move and rename the backup
echo ">>> Moving template to cache..."
BACKUP_FILE=$(ls -t /tmp/vzdump-lxc-${TEMPLATE_ID}-*.tar.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Error: Backup file not found"
    pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
    exit 1
fi

mv "${BACKUP_FILE}" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo "Template saved to: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"

# Destroy temporary container
echo ">>> Destroying temporary container..."
pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force

echo ""
echo "=== Docker LXC Template Created Successfully ==="
echo ""
echo "Template location: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""
echo "To use in OpenTofu, set:"
echo "  lxc_template = \"local:vztmpl/${OUTPUT_NAME}\""
echo ""

   228→      vars: [APP, SERVICE]
   229→
   230→  tofu:sync:compose:
   231→    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
   232→    cmds:
   233→      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
   234→    requires:
   235→      vars: [APP]
   236→
   237→  tofu:info:
   238→    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
   239→    cmds:
   240→      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh
   241→
   242→  # ===========================================================================
   243→  # Backup Operations
   244→  # ===========================================================================
   245→
   246→  backup:sync:
   247→    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
   248→    cmds:
   249→      - |
   250→        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
   251→        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
   252→        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
   253→        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
   254→        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"
   255→
   256→  backup:status:
   257→    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
   258→    cmds:
   259→      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh
   260→
   261→  backup:now:
   262→    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
   263→    requires:
   264→      vars: [APP]
   265→    cmds:
   266→      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}
   267→
   268→  backup:all:
   269→    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
   270→    cmds:
   271→      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh
   272→
   273→  backup:list:
   274→    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
   275→    requires:
   276→      vars: [APP]
   277→    cmds:
   278→      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}
   279→
   280→  backup:restore:
   281→    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
   282→    requires:
   283→      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
   284→    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
   285→    cmds:
   286→      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"
   287→
   288→  backup:immich:db:
   289→    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
   290→    cmds:
   291→      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump
   292→
   293→  backup:immich:db:restore:
   294→    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
   295→    requires:
   296→      vars: [DUMP]
   297→    cmds:
   298→      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}
   299→
   300→  # ===========================================================================
   301→  # Authelia Operations
   302→  # ===========================================================================
   303→
   304→  authelia:secrets:
   305→    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
   306→    cmds:
   307→      - |
   308→        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
   309→        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
   310→        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
   311→        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
   312→        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
   313→        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
   314→        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
   315→        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
   316→        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
   317→        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"
   318→
   319→  authelia:users:
   320→    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
   321→    cmds:
   322→      - |
   323→        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
   324→        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
   325→        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
   326→          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
   327→          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
   328→          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
   329→          exit 1
   330→        fi
   331→        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
   332→        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   333→        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   334→        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   335→        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   336→        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   337→        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   338→        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
   339→        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"
   340→
   341→  authelia:setup:
   342→    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
   343→    cmds:
   344→      - task: authelia:secrets
   345→      - task: authelia:users
   346→      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."
   347→
   348→  authelia:sync:
   349→    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
   350→    cmds:
   351→      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push
   352→
   353→  authelia:pull:
   354→    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
   355→    cmds:
   356→      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull
   357→
   358→  authelia:middleware:sync:
   359→    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
   360→    cmds:
   361→      - |
   362→        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
   363→        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
   364→        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
   365→        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
   366→          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
   367→          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
   368→          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
   369→          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
   370→          exit 1
   371→        fi
   372→
   373→        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
   374→        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
   375→        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
   376→        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"
   377→
   378→        # Sync to Traefik
   379→        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
   380→        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
   381→        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
   382→        echo ""
   383→        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
   384→        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"
   385→
   386→  # ===========================================================================
   387→  # Traefik Route Management
   388→  # ===========================================================================
   389→
   390→  traefik:routes:sync:
   391→    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
   392→    cmds:
   393→      - |
   394→        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
   395→        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
   396→        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
   397→        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."
   398→
   399→  traefik:routes:pull:
   400→    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
   401→    cmds:
   402→      - |
   403→        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
   404→        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
   405→        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"
   406→
   407→  traefik:routes:diff:

   409→    cmds:

   411→        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
   412→        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
   413→        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
   414→
   415→  # ===========================================================================
   416→  # AdGuard DNS Operations
   417→  # ===========================================================================
   418→
   419→  adguard:sync:

   421→    cmds:
   422→      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push
   423→
   424→  adguard:pull:

   426→    cmds:
   427→      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull
   428→
   429→  adguard:test:

   431→    cmds:
   432→      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test
   433→
   434→  # ===========================================================================
   435→  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)

   437→
   438→  cloud:sync:
   439→    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
   440→    cmds:

   442→        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
   443→        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
   444→        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
   445→        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
   446→        echo ""
   447→        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"

   449→        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
   450→        echo ""
   451→        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"
   452→
   453→  cloud:sync:vzdump:
   454→    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
   455→    cmds:

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.USER_WORKING_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # Import Existing Infrastructure
  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing LXC into an app's state (APP=dashboards|portainer|network-services)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    requires:
      vars: [APP, CONTAINER_ID]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing LXC (ID: {{.CONTAINER_ID}}) into {{.APP}} state..."
        tofu import 'module.docker_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/{{.CONTAINER_ID}}'

  tofu:import:traefik:
    desc: "Import existing Traefik LXC (ID 200) into state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik"
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP=traefik' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing Traefik LXC (ID: 200) into state..."
        tofu import 'module.traefik_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/200'

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Configuration
  tofu:config:create:
    desc: "Create terraform.tfvars from example"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -f terraform.tfvars ]; then
          echo "terraform.tfvars already exists. Remove it first to recreate."
          exit 1
        fi
        cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
        echo "Created terraform.tfvars - edit it with your values"

  tofu:config:edit:
    desc: "Edit terraform.tfvars"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - ${EDITOR:-vim} terraform.tfvars

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:sync:compose:
    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.USER_WORKING_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # Import Existing Infrastructure
  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing LXC into an app's state (APP=dashboards|portainer|network-services)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    requires:
      vars: [APP, CONTAINER_ID]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing LXC (ID: {{.CONTAINER_ID}}) into {{.APP}} state..."
        tofu import 'module.docker_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/{{.CONTAINER_ID}}'

  tofu:import:traefik:
    desc: "Import existing Traefik LXC (ID 200) into state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik"
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP=traefik' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing Traefik LXC (ID: 200) into state..."
        tofu import 'module.traefik_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/200'

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Configuration
  tofu:config:create:
    desc: "Create terraform.tfvars from example"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -f terraform.tfvars ]; then
          echo "terraform.tfvars already exists. Remove it first to recreate."
          exit 1
        fi
        cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
        echo "Created terraform.tfvars - edit it with your values"

  tofu:config:edit:
    desc: "Edit terraform.tfvars"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - ${EDITOR:-vim} terraform.tfvars

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:sync:compose:
    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

content.text:
Good question. Let me address the Docker vs Podman consideration:

**Docker vs Podman for your homelab:**

| Aspect | Docker | Podman |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Rootless** | Requires setup | Native support |
| **Daemonless** | No (dockerd required) | Yes |
| **LXC compatibility** | Well-tested with nesting | Can work but more edge cases |
| **Compose** | Native `docker compose` (v2) | `podman-compose` (Python) or `podman compose` (plugin) |
| **GPU passthrough** | Well documented | Works but less mature |
| **Immich/Traefik support** | Official images tested | Should work, less battle-tested |

**My recommendation: Stick with Docker** for your homelab because:

1. **Your existing services** (Immich, Traefik, etc.) are tested with Docker
2. **LXC + Docker** is a well-trodden path in the Proxmox community
3. **GPU passthrough** for hardware acceleration is better documented
4. **Compose v2** is more mature than podman-compose

However, I can add Podman support to the template script as an option if you want flexibility. The `docker-host` module already supports both runtimes via the `container_runtime` variable.

Let me update the script to support both options:

echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Create Container Runtime LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker CE or Podman pre-installed.
# This eliminates the need for null_resource runtime installation in OpenTofu.
#
# Usage:
#   ./create-docker-template.sh              # Docker (default)
#   RUNTIME=podman ./create-docker-template.sh   # Podman
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
TEMPLATE_ID="${TEMPLATE_ID:-9000}"
RUNTIME="${RUNTIME:-docker}"  # docker or podman
BASE_TEMPLATE="${BASE_TEMPLATE:-local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst}"
STORAGE="${STORAGE:-local}"
NODE="${NODE:-pve}"

# Set names based on runtime
if [ "$RUNTIME" = "podman" ]; then
    TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-podman-template}"
    OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-podman_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
else
    TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-docker-template}"
    OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
fi

echo "=== Creating ${RUNTIME^}-Ready LXC Template ==="
echo "Runtime: ${RUNTIME}"
echo "Template ID: ${TEMPLATE_ID}"
echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Create Docker-Ready LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker CE pre-installed.
# Run this script on the Proxmox host.
#
# Usage: ./create-docker-template.sh
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
TEMPLATE_ID="${TEMPLATE_ID:-9000}"
TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-docker-template}"
BASE_TEMPLATE="${BASE_TEMPLATE:-local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst}"
STORAGE="${STORAGE:-local}"
OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
NODE="${NODE:-pve}"

echo "=== Creating Docker-Ready LXC Template ==="
echo "Template ID: ${TEMPLATE_ID}"
echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

# Check if template ID is already in use
if pct status "${TEMPLATE_ID}" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "Error: Container ID ${TEMPLATE_ID} already exists"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary container
echo ">>> Creating temporary container..."
pct create "${TEMPLATE_ID}" "${BASE_TEMPLATE}" \
    --hostname "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" \
    --storage local-lvm \
    --rootfs local-lvm:8 \
    --memory 2048 \
    --cores 2 \
    --net0 name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=dhcp \
    --features nesting=1,keyctl=1 \
    --start 1

# Wait for container to be ready
echo ">>> Waiting for container to start..."
sleep 10

# Wait for network
echo ">>> Waiting for network..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Network is ready"
        break
    fi
    if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
        echo "Error: Network timeout"
        pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Install Docker
echo ">>> Installing Docker CE..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    echo "Updating packages..."
    apt-get update

    echo "Installing prerequisites..."
    apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync

    echo "Adding Docker repository..."
    install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
    rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list

    echo "Installing Docker..."
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

    echo "Enabling Docker service..."
    systemctl enable docker

    echo "Creating standard directories..."
    mkdir -p /config

    echo "Verifying Docker installation..."
    docker --version
    docker compose version

    echo "Docker installation complete!"
'

# Clean up for template
echo ">>> Cleaning up for template..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    # Stop Docker before cleanup
    systemctl stop docker || true

    # Clear machine-id (regenerated on first boot)
    truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id
    rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

    # Clear SSH host keys (regenerated on first boot)
    rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*

    # Clear logs
    find /var/log -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog 2>/dev/null || true

    # Clear apt cache
    apt-get clean
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    # Clear bash history
    rm -f /root/.bash_history

    # Clear Docker data that should be fresh per container
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/containers/*
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/network/*

    echo "Cleanup complete!"
'

# Stop container
echo ">>> Stopping container..."
pct stop "${TEMPLATE_ID}"

# Create backup (template)
echo ">>> Creating template archive..."
BACKUP_DIR="/var/lib/vz/template/cache"
vzdump "${TEMPLATE_ID}" \
    --compress zstd \
    --mode stop \
    --storage local \
    --dumpdir /tmp

# Move and rename the backup
echo ">>> Moving template to cache..."
BACKUP_FILE=$(ls -t /tmp/vzdump-lxc-${TEMPLATE_ID}-*.tar.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Error: Backup file not found"
    pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
    exit 1
fi

mv "${BACKUP_FILE}" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo "Template saved to: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"

# Destroy temporary container
echo ">>> Destroying temporary container..."
pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force

echo ""
echo "=== Docker LXC Template Created Successfully ==="
echo ""
echo "Template location: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""
echo "To use in OpenTofu, set:"
echo "  lxc_template = \"local:vztmpl/${OUTPUT_NAME}\""
echo ""

# =============================================================================
# Create Container Runtime LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker CE or Podman pre-installed.
# This eliminates the need for null_resource runtime installation in OpenTofu.
# Run this script on the Proxmox host.
#
# Usage:
#   ./create-docker-template.sh                  # Docker (default)
#   RUNTIME=podman ./create-docker-template.sh   # Podman
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
TEMPLATE_ID="${TEMPLATE_ID:-9000}"
RUNTIME="${RUNTIME:-docker}"  # docker or podman
BASE_TEMPLATE="${BASE_TEMPLATE:-local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst}"
STORAGE="${STORAGE:-local}"
NODE="${NODE:-pve}"

# Set names based on runtime
if [ "$RUNTIME" = "podman" ]; then
    TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-podman-template}"
    OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-podman_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
else
    TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-docker-template}"
    OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
fi

echo "=== Creating ${RUNTIME^}-Ready LXC Template ==="
echo "Runtime: ${RUNTIME}"
echo "Template ID: ${TEMPLATE_ID}"
echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

# Check if template ID is already in use
if pct status "${TEMPLATE_ID}" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "Error: Container ID ${TEMPLATE_ID} already exists"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary container
echo ">>> Creating temporary container..."
pct create "${TEMPLATE_ID}" "${BASE_TEMPLATE}" \
    --hostname "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" \
    --storage local-lvm \
    --rootfs local-lvm:8 \
    --memory 2048 \
    --cores 2 \
    --net0 name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=dhcp \
    --features nesting=1,keyctl=1 \
    --start 1

# Wait for container to be ready
echo ">>> Waiting for container to start..."
sleep 10

# Wait for network
echo ">>> Waiting for network..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Network is ready"
        break
    fi
    if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
        echo "Error: Network timeout"
        pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Install container runtime
if [ "$RUNTIME" = "podman" ]; then
    echo ">>> Installing Podman..."
    pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
        set -e

        echo "Updating packages..."
        apt-get update

        echo "Installing prerequisites..."
        apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl rsync

        echo "Installing Podman and podman-compose..."
        apt-get install -y podman podman-compose

        echo "Enabling Podman socket..."
        systemctl enable podman.socket

        echo "Creating standard directories..."
        mkdir -p /config

        echo "Verifying Podman installation..."
        podman --version
        podman-compose version

        echo "Podman installation complete!"
    '
else
    echo ">>> Installing Docker CE..."
    pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
        set -e

        echo "Updating packages..."
        apt-get update

        echo "Installing prerequisites..."
        apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync

        echo "Adding Docker repository..."
        install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
        rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
        curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
        chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

        echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list

        echo "Installing Docker..."
        apt-get update
        apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

        echo "Enabling Docker service..."
        systemctl enable docker

        echo "Creating standard directories..."
        mkdir -p /config

        echo "Verifying Docker installation..."
        docker --version
        docker compose version

        echo "Docker installation complete!"
    '
fi

# Clean up for template
echo ">>> Cleaning up for template..."
if [ "$RUNTIME" = "podman" ]; then
    pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
        set -e

        # Clear machine-id (regenerated on first boot)
        truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id
        rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

        # Clear SSH host keys (regenerated on first boot)
        rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*

        # Clear logs
        find /var/log -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
        truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp 2>/dev/null || true
        truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog 2>/dev/null || true

        # Clear apt cache
        apt-get clean
        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

        # Clear bash history
        rm -f /root/.bash_history

        # Clear Podman data that should be fresh per container
        rm -rf /var/lib/containers/storage/* 2>/dev/null || true

        echo "Cleanup complete!"
    '
else
    pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
        set -e

        # Stop Docker before cleanup
        systemctl stop docker || true

        # Clear machine-id (regenerated on first boot)
        truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id
        rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

        # Clear SSH host keys (regenerated on first boot)
        rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*

        # Clear logs
        find /var/log -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
        truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp 2>/dev/null || true
        truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog 2>/dev/null || true

        # Clear apt cache
        apt-get clean
        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

        # Clear bash history
        rm -f /root/.bash_history

        # Clear Docker data that should be fresh per container
        rm -rf /var/lib/docker/containers/*
        rm -rf /var/lib/docker/network/*

        echo "Cleanup complete!"
    '
fi

# Stop container
echo ">>> Stopping container..."
pct stop "${TEMPLATE_ID}"

# Create backup (template)
echo ">>> Creating template archive..."
BACKUP_DIR="/var/lib/vz/template/cache"
vzdump "${TEMPLATE_ID}" \
    --compress zstd \
    --mode stop \
    --storage local \
    --dumpdir /tmp

# Move and rename the backup
echo ">>> Moving template to cache..."
BACKUP_FILE=$(ls -t /tmp/vzdump-lxc-${TEMPLATE_ID}-*.tar.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Error: Backup file not found"
    pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
    exit 1
fi

mv "${BACKUP_FILE}" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo "Template saved to: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"

# Destroy temporary container
echo ">>> Destroying temporary container..."
pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force

echo ""
echo "=== ${RUNTIME^} LXC Template Created Successfully ==="
echo ""
echo "Template location: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""
echo "To use in OpenTofu, set:"
echo "  lxc_template = \"local:vztmpl/${OUTPUT_NAME}\""
echo ""
