#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Create Docker-Ready LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker CE pre-installed.
# This eliminates the need for null_resource Docker installation in OpenTofu.
# Run this script on the Proxmox host.
#
# Usage: ./create-docker-template.sh
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
TEMPLATE_ID="${TEMPLATE_ID:-9000}"
TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-docker-template}"
BASE_TEMPLATE="${BASE_TEMPLATE:-local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst}"
OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"

echo "=== Creating Docker-Ready LXC Template ==="
echo "Template ID: ${TEMPLATE_ID}"
echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

# Check if template ID is already in use
if pct status "${TEMPLATE_ID}" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "Error: Container ID ${TEMPLATE_ID} already exists"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary container
echo ">>> Creating temporary container..."
pct create "${TEMPLATE_ID}" "${BASE_TEMPLATE}" \
    --hostname "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" \
    --storage local-lvm \
    --rootfs local-lvm:8 \
    --memory 2048 \
    --cores 2 \
    --net0 name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=dhcp \
    --features nesting=1,keyctl=1 \
    --start 1

# Wait for container to be ready
echo ">>> Waiting for container to start..."
sleep 10

# Wait for network
echo ">>> Waiting for network..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Network is ready"
        break
    fi
    if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
        echo "Error: Network timeout"
        pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Install Docker
echo ">>> Installing Docker CE..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    echo "Updating packages..."
    apt-get update

    echo "Installing prerequisites..."
    apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync

    echo "Adding Docker repository..."
    install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
    rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list

    echo "Installing Docker..."
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

    echo "Enabling Docker service..."
    systemctl enable docker

    echo "Creating standard directories..."
    mkdir -p /config

    echo "Verifying Docker installation..."
    docker --version
    docker compose version

    echo "Docker installation complete!"
'

# Clean up for template
echo ">>> Cleaning up for template..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    # Stop Docker before cleanup
    systemctl stop docker || true

    # Clear machine-id (regenerated on first boot)
    truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id
    rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

    # Clear SSH host keys (regenerated on first boot)
    rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*

    # Clear logs
    find /var/log -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog 2>/dev/null || true

    # Clear apt cache
    apt-get clean
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    # Clear bash history
    rm -f /root/.bash_history

    # Clear Docker data that should be fresh per container
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/containers/*
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/network/*

    echo "Cleanup complete!"
'

# Stop container
echo ">>> Stopping container..."
pct stop "${TEMPLATE_ID}"

# Create backup (template)
echo ">>> Creating template archive..."
BACKUP_DIR="/var/lib/vz/template/cache"
vzdump "${TEMPLATE_ID}" \
    --compress zstd \
    --mode stop \
    --storage local \
    --dumpdir /tmp

# Move and rename the backup
echo ">>> Moving template to cache..."
BACKUP_FILE=$(ls -t /tmp/vzdump-lxc-${TEMPLATE_ID}-*.tar.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Error: Backup file not found"
    pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
    exit 1
fi

mv "${BACKUP_FILE}" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo "Template saved to: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"

# Destroy temporary container
echo ">>> Destroying temporary container..."
pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force

echo ""
echo "=== Docker LXC Template Created Successfully ==="
echo ""
echo "Template location: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""
echo "To use in OpenTofu, update shared.tf:"
echo "  lxc_template = \"local:vztmpl/${OUTPUT_NAME}\""
echo ""

toolUseResult.originalFile:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Create Docker-Ready LXC Template
# =============================================================================
# Creates a Debian 13 LXC template with Docker CE pre-installed.
# This eliminates the need for null_resource Docker installation in OpenTofu.
# Run this script on the Proxmox host.
#
# Usage: ./create-docker-template.sh
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
TEMPLATE_ID="${TEMPLATE_ID:-9000}"
TEMPLATE_NAME="${TEMPLATE_NAME:-debian-13-docker-template}"
BASE_TEMPLATE="${BASE_TEMPLATE:-local:vztmpl/debian-13-standard_13.1-2_amd64.tar.zst}"
OUTPUT_NAME="${OUTPUT_NAME:-debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst}"
STORAGE="${STORAGE:-nvme-containers}"

echo "=== Creating Docker-Ready LXC Template ==="
echo "Template ID: ${TEMPLATE_ID}"
echo "Template Name: ${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
echo "Base Template: ${BASE_TEMPLATE}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""

# Check if template ID is already in use
if pct status "${TEMPLATE_ID}" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "Error: Container ID ${TEMPLATE_ID} already exists"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary container
echo ">>> Creating temporary container..."
pct create "${TEMPLATE_ID}" "${BASE_TEMPLATE}" \
    --hostname "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" \
    --storage "${STORAGE}" \
    --rootfs "${STORAGE}:4" \
    --memory 512 \
    --cores 2 \
    --net0 name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=dhcp \
    --features nesting=1,keyctl=1 \
    --start 1

# Wait for container to be ready
echo ">>> Waiting for container to start..."
sleep 10

# Wait for network
echo ">>> Waiting for network..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Network is ready"
        break
    fi
    if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
        echo "Error: Network timeout"
        pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# Install Docker
echo ">>> Installing Docker CE..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    echo "Updating packages..."
    apt-get update

    echo "Installing prerequisites..."
    apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg rsync

    echo "Adding Docker repository..."
    install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
    rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
    chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list

    echo "Installing Docker..."
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

    echo "Enabling Docker service..."
    systemctl enable docker

    echo "Creating standard directories..."
    mkdir -p /config

    echo "Verifying Docker installation..."
    docker --version
    docker compose version

    echo "Docker installation complete!"
'

# Clean up for template
echo ">>> Cleaning up for template..."
pct exec "${TEMPLATE_ID}" -- bash -c '
    set -e

    # Stop Docker before cleanup
    systemctl stop docker || true

    # Clear machine-id (regenerated on first boot)
    truncate -s 0 /etc/machine-id
    rm -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

    # Clear SSH host keys (regenerated on first boot)
    rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*

    # Clear logs
    find /var/log -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/wtmp 2>/dev/null || true
    truncate -s 0 /var/log/lastlog 2>/dev/null || true

    # Clear apt cache
    apt-get clean
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    # Clear bash history
    rm -f /root/.bash_history

    # Clear Docker data that should be fresh per container
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/containers/*
    rm -rf /var/lib/docker/network/*

    echo "Cleanup complete!"
'

# Stop container
echo ">>> Stopping container..."
pct stop "${TEMPLATE_ID}"

# Create backup (template)
echo ">>> Creating template archive..."
BACKUP_DIR="/var/lib/vz/template/cache"
vzdump "${TEMPLATE_ID}" \
    --compress zstd \
    --mode stop \
    --storage local \
    --dumpdir /tmp

# Move and rename the backup
echo ">>> Moving template to cache..."
BACKUP_FILE=$(ls -t /tmp/vzdump-lxc-${TEMPLATE_ID}-*.tar.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Error: Backup file not found"
    pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force
    exit 1
fi

mv "${BACKUP_FILE}" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo "Template saved to: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"

# Destroy temporary container
echo ">>> Destroying temporary container..."
pct destroy "${TEMPLATE_ID}" --force

echo ""
echo "=== Docker LXC Template Created Successfully ==="
echo ""
echo "Template location: ${BACKUP_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"
echo ""
echo "To use in OpenTofu, update shared.tf:"
echo "  lxc_template = \"local:vztmpl/${OUTPUT_NAME}\""
echo ""

    95→resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
    96→  depends_on = [module.lxc]
    97→
    98→  triggers = {
    99→    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
   100→  }

   102→  provisioner "local-exec" {

   123→  triggers = {

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# Architecture:
#   1. LXC container (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Docker runtime installation (null_resource)
#   3. Config files sync (filesync provider)
#   4. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# All resources in ONE state file for atomic updates.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Enable nesting for Docker
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  template = var.lxc_template

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Docker
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_docker" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config/static /config/dynamic /config/certs /config/logs"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Static Config (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_static_config" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/static/traefik.yml"
  destination = "/config/static/traefik.yml"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sync Dynamic Configs (filesync provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_directory" "traefik_dynamic_configs" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/dynamic"
  destination = "/config/dynamic"
  host        = module.lxc.ip_address

  owner = "root"
  group = "root"
  mode  = "0644"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "create_env_file" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.install_docker]

  triggers = {
    env_hash = sha256("${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}:darshanrambhia@live.com")
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "cat > /config/.env << 'ENVEOF'",
      "CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}",
      "CF_API_EMAIL=darshanrambhia@live.com",
      "ENVEOF",
      "chmod 600 /config/.env"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack (remotedockercompose provider)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "traefik" {
  depends_on = [
    null_resource.install_docker,
    filesync_file.traefik_static_config,
    filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs,
    null_resource.create_env_file
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "Traefik"
  description  = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Static config:** `/config/static/traefik.yml`
**Dynamic configs:** `/config/dynamic/*.yml`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f traefik
```

**Restart Traefik:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart traefik
```

**Check certificates:**
```
docker exec traefik cat /config/certs/acme.json | jq '.letsencrypt.Certificates[].domain.main'
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

This deployment uses custom providers:
- `filesync` - Syncs static/dynamic config files
- `remotedockercompose` - Manages Docker Compose stack

Run `task tofu:apply APP=traefik` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

output "filesync_static_hash" {
  description = "Hash of static config for drift detection"
  value       = filesync_file.traefik_static_config.source_hash
}

output "filesync_dynamic_hash" {
  description = "Hash of dynamic configs for drift detection"
  value       = filesync_directory.traefik_dynamic_configs.source_hash
}

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create /config directory
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "setup_config_dir" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "mkdir -p /config",
      "systemctl start docker"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "n8n" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.setup_config_dir]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create /config directory
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "setup_config_dir" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "mkdir -p /config",
      "systemctl start docker"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "n8n" {
  provider   = remotedockercompose
  depends_on = [null_resource.setup_config_dir]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

The issue is that the module always tries to set keyctl in the features block. The API token can only set `nesting=true`. For unprivileged containers, we need to avoid setting keyctl via the API.

Looking at the module logic, it appears the `configure_privileged_container` resource only runs for privileged containers (`!var.unprivileged`). But n8n uses an unprivileged container by default.

The actual problem: the API token cannot set `keyctl=true` on ANY container type - it requires root@pam. The module should not set keyctl via the API at all, and should use SSH to configure it afterward.

Let me update the lxc-base module to not set keyctl via the API - only nesting can be set via API token:

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create /config directory
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "setup_config_dir" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "mkdir -p /config",
      "systemctl start docker"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "n8n" {
  provider   = remotedockercompose
  depends_on = [null_resource.setup_config_dir]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # SSH to Proxmox host for configuring features (keyctl requires root@pam)
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create /config directory
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "setup_config_dir" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "mkdir -p /config",
      "systemctl start docker"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "n8n" {
  provider   = remotedockercompose
  depends_on = [null_resource.setup_config_dir]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

The issue is that the reboot is in the background, so `configure_container_features` completes immediately and the `time_sleep` starts while the container is rebooting. Then the next step tries to use the IP which isn't available yet.

Let me increase the wait and also add a wait-for-reboot in the configure step:

input.old_string:
inline = [
      # Configure AppArmor profile for Docker support (only for privileged containers)
      var.unprivileged ? "echo 'Unprivileged container - skipping apparmor config'" : "grep -q 'lxc.apparmor.profile' /etc/pve/lxc/${var.container_id}.conf || echo 'lxc.apparmor.profile: unconfined' >> /etc/pve/lxc/${var.container_id}.conf",

      # Configure features via pct set (more reliable than direct conf editing)
      "pct set ${var.container_id} --features nesting=${var.enable_nesting ? 1 : 0},keyctl=${var.enable_keyctl ? 1 : 0},fuse=${var.enable_fuse ? 1 : 0}",

      # Restart container to apply changes (run in background to avoid SSH disconnect)
      # Use nohup and & to ensure command completes even if SSH session ends
      "if pct status ${var.container_id} | grep -q running; then nohup sh -c 'sleep 1 && pct reboot ${var.container_id}' >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi",
      "echo 'Container ${var.container_id} configured: nesting=${var.enable_nesting}, keyctl=${var.enable_keyctl}, fuse=${var.enable_fuse}'"
    ]

      "echo 'Container ${var.container_id} configured: nesting=${var.enable_nesting}, keyctl=${var.enable_keyctl}, fuse=${var.enable_fuse}'"
    ]

content.text:
The IP is still showing as "pending" despite the wait. The issue is that `module.lxc.ip_address` comes from the Proxmox provider's data attribute which isn't refreshed after the restart. The IP is read at plan time, not execution time.

The real solution is to not use `module.lxc.ip_address` in the subsequent provisioners, but instead to query the IP dynamically. However, that's a bigger change.

Let me take a different approach - skip the restart for now and just see if Docker works without the restart:

The n8n deployment is complete and working. Let me provide a summary of what was accomplished and what issues were encountered:

## Summary

**n8n is now successfully deployed and accessible at https://n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev/**

### What was accomplished:

1. **Created Docker-ready LXC template** - A Debian 13 template with Docker pre-installed, eliminating runtime installation
2. **Created n8n app structure** using the new deployment architecture:
   - [main.tf](tofu/apps/n8n/main.tf) - Uses lxc-base module with Docker template + remote-docker-compose-file provider
   - [docker-compose.yml](tofu/apps/n8n/deploy/docker-compose.yml) - n8n service definition
   - [n8n.yml](tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/n8n.yml) - Traefik route configuration

3. **Fixed several issues along the way:**
   - **API token permissions**: Can't set keyctl/fuse features via API - fixed by using SSH to configure via `pct set`
   - **Privileged container features**: API tokens can't set ANY features on privileged containers - fixed with dynamic `features` block
   - **Provider path expansion**: `~` in ssh_key_path wasn't expanded - fixed with `pathexpand()`
   - **IP address timing**: Container reboot caused IP to show as "pending" - fundamental issue with Proxmox provider

### Current state:
- **Container**: 502 (n8n) running at 192.168.1.213
- **Service**: n8n accessible via Traefik at https://n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev/
- **Health**: Container healthy, Docker running

### Remaining work to improve:
The module changes to [lxc-base/main.tf](tofu/modules/lxc-base/main.tf) introduced a timing issue where the IP address isn't available after the container restart for feature configuration. The manual deployment worked because we used the actual IP, but the automated flow still has this race condition. This is a known limitation of the Proxmox provider not refreshing container IPs during apply.

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Use privileged container for full Docker compatibility
  # (unprivileged containers can't run all Docker images due to sysctl restrictions)
  unprivileged = false

  # SSH to Proxmox host for configuring features (keyctl requires root@pam)
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create /config directory
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "setup_config_dir" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "mkdir -p /config",
      "systemctl start docker"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "n8n" {
  provider   = remotedockercompose
  depends_on = [null_resource.setup_config_dir]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

And via Traefik:

**The static IP approach works.** Here's a summary:

## Static IP Solution

The key changes were:

1. **Added `ip_address` and `gateway` variables** to [lxc-base/variables.tf](tofu/modules/lxc-base/variables.tf):
   ```hcl
   variable "ip_address" {
     description = "Static IP in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.100/24). Leave empty for DHCP."
     type        = string
     default     = ""
   }
   
   variable "gateway" {
     description = "Default gateway IP. Required if using static IP."
     type        = string
     default     = "192.168.1.1"
   }
   ```

2. **Updated IP config** in [lxc-base/main.tf](tofu/modules/lxc-base/main.tf) to use static when provided:
   ```hcl
   ip_config {
     ipv4 {
       address = var.ip_address != "" ? var.ip_address : "dhcp"
       gateway = var.ip_address != "" ? var.gateway : null
     }
   }
   ```

3. **Updated outputs** to return static IP directly when configured:
   ```hcl
   value = var.ip_address != "" ? split("/", var.ip_address)[0] : try(...)
   ```

4. **Used static IP in n8n** ([n8n/main.tf](tofu/apps/n8n/main.tf)):
   ```hcl
   ip_address = "192.168.1.213/24"
   gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
   ```

**Benefits:**
- IP address is known at plan time
- No race condition with container restart
- Downstream resources (docker-compose, Traefik) can reliably reference the IP
- More predictable infrastructure

**Note:** The DNS inherited from the template was wrong (Tailscale DNS). You may want to bake proper DNS into the Docker template or configure it via the module.

The key improvements from this session:

1. **Docker-ready LXC template** - Eliminates runtime Docker installation
2. **Static IP support in lxc-base module** - Avoids "pending" IP race conditions
3. **Privileged container handling** - API token limitations worked around via SSH
4. **Custom providers** - `remote-docker-compose-file` and `filesync` for cleaner deployments

Good thinking - 192.168.1.0/24 only gives you 254 usable IPs. Here are your options:

## Option 1: Expand to 10.x.x.x (Recommended)

**10.0.0.0/8** gives you ~16 million IPs. You could segment it logically:

```
10.1.0.0/24   - Core infrastructure (Proxmox, router, switches)
10.1.1.0/24   - LXC containers
10.1.2.0/24   - VMs
10.1.3.0/24   - Docker networks
10.1.10.0/24  - IoT devices
10.1.20.0/24  - Management/IPMI
```

**Migration path:**
1. Add a secondary IP to Proxmox on 10.x.x.x
2. Create a new bridge (vmbr1) or add 10.x to existing vmbr0
3. Migrate containers one by one
4. Update router/DHCP to hand out 10.x addresses
5. Eventually decommission 192.168.1.x

## Option 2: Larger 192.168.x.x subnet

Use **192.168.0.0/16** (65K IPs):
```
192.168.1.0/24   - Existing LAN (keep as-is)
192.168.10.0/24  - LXC containers
192.168.20.0/24  - VMs
```

Less disruptive since you keep existing devices on 192.168.1.x.

## Option 3: VLANs with different subnets

Segment traffic with VLANs:
```
VLAN 1  (untagged): 192.168.1.0/24  - Default LAN
VLAN 10: 10.10.10.0/24              - Containers
VLAN 20: 10.10.20.0/24              - VMs
VLAN 30: 10.10.30.0/24              - IoT
```

Requires VLAN-capable switch and router configuration.

---

**For Proxmox specifically**, yes you can move it to 10.x.x.x:

1. SSH to Proxmox while still on 192.168.1.215
2. Edit `/etc/network/interfaces`:
   ```
   auto vmbr0
   iface vmbr0 inet static
       address 10.1.0.1/24
       gateway 10.1.0.254
       bridge-ports enp1s0
       bridge-stp off
       bridge-fd 0
   ```
3. Update `/etc/hosts` 
4. Reboot (or `ifreload -a`)

**What's your current router setup?** That determines how easy the migration is - if it's something like OPNsense/pfSense, adding a new subnet is straightforward. If it's a consumer router, you may need to replace it or run your own DHCP server.
I cant really run a dhcp server that easily yet. and i own a consumer router  from verizon fios

Ah, Verizon FIOS router - that's limiting. Those typically only let you change the DHCP range within 192.168.1.x, not add new subnets.

## Realistic Options for You

### Option 1: Expand within 192.168.1.0/24 (Simplest)

Just be more strategic with IP allocation:

```
192.168.1.1       - Router (Verizon)
192.168.1.2-50    - DHCP for regular devices
192.168.1.100-199 - LXC containers (static)
192.168.1.200-220 - VMs (static)
192.168.1.221-240 - Infrastructure (Proxmox, NAS, etc.)
```

That gives you ~100 IPs for containers which is plenty for a homelab.

### Option 2: Run AdGuard/Pi-hole as DHCP (You have this!)

You already have AdGuard Home in your network-services. You could:
1. Disable DHCP on the Verizon router
2. Enable DHCP on AdGuard Home
3. Configure it to hand out a larger range or different subnet

But this requires AdGuard to be highly available - if it goes down, no new DHCP leases.

### Option 3: Static IPs for everything managed by OpenTofu

Since you're using OpenTofu for containers anyway, just assign static IPs to everything you deploy. The Verizon router's DHCP only matters for phones/laptops/etc.

You could add an IP registry to your repo:

```hcl
# tofu/ip-registry.tf
locals {
  ips = {
    # Infrastructure
    proxmox     = "192.168.1.215"
    traefik     = "192.168.1.162"
    
    # Containers (100-199)
    portainer   = "192.168.1.100"
    adguard     = "192.168.1.101"
    monitoring  = "192.168.1.102"
    n8n         = "192.168.1.213"
    # ... etc
  }
}
```

### Option 4: Replace Verizon Router (Future)

Put the Verizon router in bridge/passthrough mode and run OPNsense/pfSense in a VM or dedicated box. Then you have full control over subnets, VLANs, firewall rules, etc.

---

**My recommendation**: Option 3 for now (static IPs with a registry), and plan for Option 4 when you're ready. 100 IPs in the container range is enough for most homelabs, and static IPs are more reliable anyway.

input.content:
# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Usage:
#   1. When deploying a new service, check `local.next_available_ip` for the
#      next free IP in the LXC range (192.168.1.150-199)
#   2. Add the new allocation to the appropriate category below
#   3. Use `local.ip_registry.<category>.<name>` in your module configs
#
# Ranges:
#   - 192.168.1.1-99:     Infrastructure (router, Proxmox, switches)
#   - 192.168.1.100-149:  Core services (Traefik, Portainer, DNS)
#   - 192.168.1.150-199:  LXC containers (apps)
#   - 192.168.1.200-224:  Reserved for manual/temporary use
#   - 192.168.1.225-254:  Special services & overflow
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    netmask = "/24"
    prefix  = "192.168.1"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - All Static Allocations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure devices (1-99)
    infrastructure = {
      router           = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox          = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host
    }

    # Core services (100-149)
    core = {
      portainer        = "192.168.1.157"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Unbound
      traefik          = "192.168.1.162"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
    }

    # Application LXCs (150-199 preferred range for new deployments)
    apps = {
      dashboards       = "192.168.1.234"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia         = "192.168.1.225"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
      immich_importer  = "192.168.1.159"  # LXC 303 - Photo import (estimated)
      immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
      jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "192.168.1.227"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack (Radarr, Sonarr, etc)
      monitoring       = "192.168.1.229"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui        = "192.168.1.221"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n              = "192.168.1.213"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
    }

    # Reserved IPs (for future use or manual assignment)
    reserved = {
      # 192.168.1.200-224 - Manual/temporary use
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for collision detection
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_allocated_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.infrastructure),
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.apps),
  )

  # Extract the last octet from each IP for range calculations
  _allocated_octets = [
    for ip in local._all_allocated_ips : tonumber(split(".", ip)[3])
  ]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Next Available IP Calculator
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scans the preferred LXC range (150-199) for the next free IP.
  # Falls back to extended range (200-224) if primary is full.

  # Primary range: 150-199 (50 IPs for LXC apps)
  _primary_range = [for i in range(150, 200) : i]

  # Secondary range: 200-212 (for overflow, avoiding special services at 213+)
  _secondary_range = [for i in range(200, 213) : i]

  # Find first available in primary range
  _available_primary = [
    for octet in local._primary_range : octet
    if !contains(local._allocated_octets, octet)
  ]

  # Find first available in secondary range
  _available_secondary = [
    for octet in local._secondary_range : octet
    if !contains(local._allocated_octets, octet)
  ]

  # The next available IP (primary range first, then secondary)
  next_available_ip = length(local._available_primary) > 0 ? (
    "${local.network.prefix}.${local._available_primary[0]}"
  ) : (
    length(local._available_secondary) > 0 ? (
      "${local.network.prefix}.${local._available_secondary[0]}"
    ) : "NO_IPS_AVAILABLE"
  )

  # Full CIDR notation for direct use in lxc-base module
  next_available_ip_cidr = "${local.next_available_ip}${local.network.netmask}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Usage: local.ip_cidr["dashboards"] -> "192.168.1.234/24"
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.infrastructure,
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.apps,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping (for reference)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    200 = local.ip_registry.core.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.apps.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.apps.authelia
    303 = local.ip_registry.apps.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.apps.immich
    401 = local.ip_registry.apps.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.apps.media_management
    500 = local.ip_registry.apps.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.apps.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.apps.n8n
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "next_available_ip" {
  description = "Next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
  value       = local.next_available_ip
}

output "next_available_ip_cidr" {
  description = "Next available IP with CIDR notation (for lxc-base module)"
  value       = local.next_available_ip_cidr
}

output "allocated_ips" {
  description = "All currently allocated IP addresses"
  value       = local._all_allocated_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}
