    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

tasks:
  # Temporary Desktop LXC (for Google Takeout downloads)
  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenTofu IaC Commands (Per-App State)
  # ===========================================================================
  # Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
  # Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer to specify which app

  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:auto:
    desc: "Plan and apply without confirmation"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply -auto-approve
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  # Import Existing Infrastructure
  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing LXC into an app's state (APP=dashboards|portainer|network-services)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    requires:
      vars: [APP, CONTAINER_ID]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing LXC (ID: {{.CONTAINER_ID}}) into {{.APP}} state..."
        tofu import 'module.docker_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/{{.CONTAINER_ID}}'

  tofu:import:traefik:
    desc: "Import existing Traefik LXC (ID 200) into state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik"
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/traefik/.terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP=traefik' first"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Importing Traefik LXC (ID: 200) into state..."
        tofu import 'module.traefik_host.module.lxc.proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc' 'pve/200'

  # State Encryption Setup
  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  # Configuration
  tofu:config:create:
    desc: "Create terraform.tfvars from example"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -f terraform.tfvars ]; then
          echo "terraform.tfvars already exists. Remove it first to recreate."
          exit 1
        fi
        cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
        echo "Created terraform.tfvars - edit it with your values"

  tofu:config:edit:
    desc: "Edit terraform.tfvars"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - ${EDITOR:-vim} terraform.tfvars

  # Utility Commands
  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:sync:compose:
    desc: "Sync compose files to a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/app-sync.sh {{.APP}} push
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Backup Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  backup:sync:
    desc: "Sync backup configs (jobs.cfg + hook script) to Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing backup configuration to Proxmox..."
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/jobs.cfg root@homelab:/etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        scp {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh root@homelab:/var/lib/vz/snippets/
        ssh root@homelab "chmod +x /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"
        echo "Backup configuration synced successfully"

  backup:status:
    desc: "Show backup storage status and recent backups"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-status.sh

  backup:now:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-app.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:all:
    desc: "Trigger immediate backup for all containers"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

  backup:list:
    desc: "List backups for an app (APP=dashboards|immich|etc)"
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/backup-list.sh {{.APP}}

  backup:restore:
    desc: "Restore container from backup (BACKUP=filename, TARGET_ID=container_id)"
    requires:
      vars: [BACKUP, TARGET_ID]
    prompt: "This will restore {{.BACKUP}} to container {{.TARGET_ID}}. Continue?"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct restore {{.TARGET_ID}} /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/{{.BACKUP}} --storage nvme-containers"

  backup:immich:db:
    desc: "Manually dump Immich PostgreSQL database"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh dump

  backup:immich:db:restore:
    desc: "Restore Immich database from dump (DUMP=filename)"
    requires:
      vars: [DUMP]
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/backup/immich-db.sh restore {{.DUMP}}

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task authelia:sync' to deploy."

  authelia:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia config from repo to container and restart"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh push

  authelia:pull:
    desc: "Pull Authelia config from container to repo (for backing up changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/authelia-sync.sh pull

  authelia:middleware:sync:
    desc: "Sync Authelia middleware to Traefik (requires Authelia to be deployed first)"
    cmds:
      - |
        # Get Authelia IP from tofu output
        cd {{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/authelia
        IP=$(tofu output -raw ip_address 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "null" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: Could not get Authelia IP. Deploy Authelia first:"
          echo "  task tofu:init APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:plan APP=authelia"
          echo "  task tofu:apply APP=authelia"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Update the middleware config with actual IP
        MIDDLEWARE_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/configs/traefik/dynamic/authelia.yml"
        sed -i '' "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || \
        sed -i "s/AUTHELIA_IP/$IP/g" "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE"

        # Sync to Traefik
        echo "Syncing Authelia middleware to Traefik (IP: $IP)..."
        scp "$MIDDLEWARE_FILE" root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/authelia.yml
        echo "Authelia middleware synced to Traefik"
        echo ""
        echo "To protect a service, add 'authelia' to its middlewares list:"
        echo "  middlewares = [\"security-headers\", \"authelia\"]"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Traefik Route Management
  # ===========================================================================

  traefik:routes:sync:
    desc: "Sync all Traefik route configs to Traefik LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Syncing Traefik routes to 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --delete --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/
        ssh root@192.168.1.162 'chown -R traefik:traefik /config/dynamic'
        echo "Routes synced. Traefik will auto-reload."

  traefik:routes:pull:
    desc: "Pull Traefik route configs from Traefik LXC to repo"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Pulling Traefik routes from 192.168.1.162..."
        rsync -av --no-owner --no-group root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/ {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/
        echo "Routes pulled to tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/"

  traefik:routes:diff:
    desc: "Show differences between local and remote Traefik routes"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Comparing local vs remote Traefik routes..."
        diff -r {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ <(ssh root@192.168.1.162 'cat /config/dynamic/*.yml') 2>/dev/null || \
        rsync -avn --no-owner --no-group {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/ root@192.168.1.162:/config/dynamic/

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:sync:
    desc: "Sync AdGuard config from repo to container"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh push

  adguard:pull:
    desc: "Pull AdGuard config from container to repo (for backing up UI changes)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh pull

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)
  # ===========================================================================

  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # LXC Template Management
  # ===========================================================================

  template:docker:create:
    desc: "Create Docker-ready Debian LXC template on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh debian

  template:docker:create:ubuntu:
    desc: "Create Docker-ready Ubuntu LXC template on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh ubuntu

  template:list:
    desc: "List available LXC templates on Proxmox"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh list

  template:docker:check:
    desc: "Check if Docker template exists"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/template/deploy.sh check

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - |
        NEXT_IP=$(tofu output -raw next_available_ip 2>/dev/null)
        NEXT_CIDR=$(tofu output -raw next_available_ip_cidr 2>/dev/null)
        echo "Next available IP: $NEXT_IP"
        echo "For lxc-base module: ip_address = \"$NEXT_CIDR\""

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - |
        tofu output -json ip_registry 2>/dev/null | jq -r '
          "=== Infrastructure ===",
          (.infrastructure | to_entries[] | "  " + .key + " = " + .value),
          "",
          "=== Core Services ===",
          (.core | to_entries[] | "  " + .key + " = " + .value),
          "",
          "=== Applications ===",
          (.apps | to_entries[] | "  " + .key + " = " + .value)'

# Use any app dir - they all have the same ip-registry.tf symlinked
APP_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/dashboards"

if [ ! -d "$APP_DIR/.terraform" ]; then

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab on Proxmox. All commands run from local machine.

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# Utility commands
task tofu:ssh APP=dashboards           # SSH to LXC
task tofu:sync:compose APP=dashboards  # Sync compose files
task tofu:logs APP=dashboards SERVICE=homepage

# Desktop LXC (temporary GUI for downloads)
task desktop:create
task desktop:info
task desktop:destroy

# Backup operations
task backup:status                 # View backup status
task backup:now APP=immich         # Manual backup
task backup:all                    # Backup all containers
task backup:list APP=immich        # List backups
task backup:restore BACKUP=file TARGET_ID=305
task backup:immich:db              # Dump Immich database
```

## Architecture

- **Proxmox Host**: 192.168.1.215 (SSH: `ssh root@homelab`)
- **Traefik LXC**: 192.168.1.162 (ID: 200)
- **Monitoring LXC**: 192.168.1.229 (ID: 500)
- **IaC**: OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox provider
- **Secrets**: 1Password CLI (`op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"`)

## Project Structure

```text
tofu/
├── apps/              # Per-app configs with own state
│   ├── dashboards/    # Homepage + Dashy (ID: 201)
│   ├── immich/        # Photo management (ID: 304)
│   ├── monitoring/    # Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting (ID: 500)
│   ├── network-services/  # AdGuard DNS (ID: 101)
│   ├── openwebui/     # AI chat (ID: 501)
│   ├── portainer/     # Container UI (ID: 100)
│   └── traefik/       # Reverse proxy (ID: 200)
├── configs/traefik/dynamic/  # Generated route configs
├── modules/           # Reusable modules
└── shared.tf          # Common vars (symlinked)
```

## Key Modules

- **docker-host**: LXC + Docker + compose deployment
- **file-sync**: Rsync file transfers to LXCs
- **proxmox-notes**: Update LXC description in Proxmox UI

## Network Domains

- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal (Traefik websecure)
- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public (Cloudflare tunnel via web entrypoint)

## Monitoring Stack

The monitoring LXC (ID: 500, IP: 192.168.1.229) runs:

| Component | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| OpenTelemetry Collector | 4317/4318 | OTLP receiver (gRPC/HTTP) |
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics storage + alerting |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing (ntfy + Discord) |
| Grafana | 3000 | Dashboards |
| Uptime Kuma | 3001 | HTTP monitoring |
| ntfy | 8080 | Push notifications |

### Key URLs

- Grafana: `https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Prometheus: `https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Alertmanager: `https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Uptime Kuma: `https://status.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- ntfy: `https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev`

### Syncing Monitoring Config

```bash
rsync -avz tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/ root@192.168.1.229:/config/
ssh root@192.168.1.229 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
```

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider (`1password/onepassword`).

### Key Files

- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Data sources + `local.op` helper (symlinked to apps)
- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

### Available Secrets

```hcl
local.op.proxmox_api_token       # Proxmox API authentication
local.op.cloudflare_api_token    # Cloudflare DNS/tunnel API
local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

   ```hcl
   data "onepassword_item" "myservice" {
     vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
     title = "myservice"
   }
   ```

3. Add to `local.op` map in same file:

   ```hcl
   op = {
     myservice_password = data.onepassword_item.myservice.password
     # For section fields, flatten first then lookup:
     myservice_api_key = lookup(local._myservice_fields, "api_key", "")
   }
   ```

4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Field Access Patterns

```hcl
# Main password field
data.onepassword_item.myitem.password

# Credential field (API keys)
data.onepassword_item.myitem.credential

# Custom fields in sections (must flatten):
locals {
  _myitem_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.myitem.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)
}
# Then: lookup(local._myitem_fields, "field_label", "")
```

### Why TF_VAR for State Encryption

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml
env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

### 1Password Items (homelab vault)

| Item | Fields |
|------|--------|
| `opentofu` | password, proxmox_api_token (section) |
| `Cloudflare` | tunnel_token, ddns_api_token (sections) |
| `grafana` | password |
| `discord-alertmanager-webhook` | credential |

## Important Notes

- SSH to Proxmox: `ssh root@homelab`
- SSH to Monitoring: `ssh root@192.168.1.229`
- Use IP addresses in provisioners (not hostnames)
- State files are encrypted and committed to git
- Each app has independent state in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ required (uses biometric auth)

## Key Modules

- **lxc-base**: Base LXC container with static IP support
- **docker-host**: LXC + Docker + compose deployment
- **file-sync**: Rsync file transfers to LXCs
- **proxmox-notes**: Update LXC description in Proxmox UI

## IP Address Management

All static IPs are tracked in `tofu/ip-registry.tf` (symlinked to all apps).

### IP Ranges

| Range | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| 192.168.1.1-99 | Infrastructure (router, Proxmox, switches) |
| 192.168.1.100-149 | Core services (Traefik, Portainer, DNS) |
| 192.168.1.150-199 | LXC containers (apps) - **preferred for new deployments** |
| 192.168.1.200-224 | Reserved for manual/temporary use |
| 192.168.1.225-254 | Special services & overflow |

### Deploying a New Service

1. Get the next available IP:
   ```bash
   task ip:next
   # Output: Next available IP: 192.168.1.150
   # For lxc-base module: ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
   ```

2. Add the IP to `tofu/ip-registry.tf`:
   ```hcl
   apps = {
     # ... existing entries ...
     my_new_service = "192.168.1.150"  # LXC XXX - Description
   }
   ```

3. Use in your app's main.tf:
   ```hcl
   module "lxc" {
     source = "../../modules/lxc-base"
     # ...
     ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
     gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
   }
   ```

### Viewing All Allocations

```bash
task ip:list
```

# Homelab Infrastructure

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# Utility commands
task tofu:ssh APP=dashboards           # SSH to LXC
task tofu:sync:compose APP=dashboards  # Sync compose files
task tofu:logs APP=dashboards SERVICE=homepage

# Desktop LXC (temporary GUI for downloads)
task desktop:create
task desktop:info
task desktop:destroy

# Backup operations
task backup:status                 # View backup status
task backup:now APP=immich         # Manual backup
task backup:all                    # Backup all containers
task backup:list APP=immich        # List backups
task backup:restore BACKUP=file TARGET_ID=305
task backup:immich:db              # Dump Immich database

# IP address management
task ip:next                       # Get next available IP for new LXC
task ip:list                       # Show all allocated IPs
```

## Architecture

- **Proxmox Host**: 192.168.1.215 (SSH: `ssh root@homelab`)
- **Traefik LXC**: 192.168.1.162 (ID: 200)
- **Monitoring LXC**: 192.168.1.229 (ID: 500)
- **IaC**: OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox provider
- **Secrets**: 1Password CLI (`op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"`)

## Project Structure

```text
tofu/
├── apps/              # Per-app configs with own state
│   ├── dashboards/    # Homepage + Dashy (ID: 201)
│   ├── immich/        # Photo management (ID: 304)
│   ├── monitoring/    # Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting (ID: 500)
│   ├── network-services/  # AdGuard DNS (ID: 101)
│   ├── openwebui/     # AI chat (ID: 501)
│   ├── portainer/     # Container UI (ID: 100)
│   └── traefik/       # Reverse proxy (ID: 200)
├── configs/traefik/dynamic/  # Generated route configs
├── modules/           # Reusable modules
└── shared.tf          # Common vars (symlinked)
```

## Key Modules

- **docker-host**: LXC + Docker + compose deployment
- **file-sync**: Rsync file transfers to LXCs
- **proxmox-notes**: Update LXC description in Proxmox UI

## Network Domains

- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal (Traefik websecure)
- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public (Cloudflare tunnel via web entrypoint)

## Monitoring Stack

The monitoring LXC (ID: 500, IP: 192.168.1.229) runs:

| Component | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| OpenTelemetry Collector | 4317/4318 | OTLP receiver (gRPC/HTTP) |
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics storage + alerting |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing (ntfy + Discord) |
| Grafana | 3000 | Dashboards |
| Uptime Kuma | 3001 | HTTP monitoring |
| ntfy | 8080 | Push notifications |

### Key URLs

- Grafana: `https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Prometheus: `https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Alertmanager: `https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Uptime Kuma: `https://status.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- ntfy: `https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev`

### Syncing Monitoring Config

```bash
rsync -avz tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/ root@192.168.1.229:/config/
ssh root@192.168.1.229 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
```

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider (`1password/onepassword`).

### Key Files

- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Data sources + `local.op` helper (symlinked to apps)
- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

### Available Secrets

```hcl
local.op.proxmox_api_token       # Proxmox API authentication
local.op.cloudflare_api_token    # Cloudflare DNS/tunnel API
local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

   ```hcl
   data "onepassword_item" "myservice" {
     vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
     title = "myservice"
   }
   ```

3. Add to `local.op` map in same file:

   ```hcl
   op = {
     myservice_password = data.onepassword_item.myservice.password
     # For section fields, flatten first then lookup:
     myservice_api_key = lookup(local._myservice_fields, "api_key", "")
   }
   ```

4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Field Access Patterns

```hcl
# Main password field
data.onepassword_item.myitem.password

# Credential field (API keys)
data.onepassword_item.myitem.credential

# Custom fields in sections (must flatten):
locals {
  _myitem_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.myitem.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)
}
# Then: lookup(local._myitem_fields, "field_label", "")
```

### Why TF_VAR for State Encryption

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml
env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

### 1Password Items (homelab vault)

| Item | Fields |
|------|--------|
| `opentofu` | password, proxmox_api_token (section) |
| `Cloudflare` | tunnel_token, ddns_api_token (sections) |
| `grafana` | password |
| `discord-alertmanager-webhook` | credential |

## Important Notes

- SSH to Proxmox: `ssh root@homelab`
- SSH to Monitoring: `ssh root@192.168.1.229`
- Use IP addresses in provisioners (not hostnames)
- State files are encrypted and committed to git
- Each app has independent state in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ required (uses biometric auth)

Done! Here's a summary of what I created:

## IP Registry System

### Files Created

1. **[tofu/ip-registry.tf](tofu/ip-registry.tf)** - Central IP registry with:
   - All current IP allocations organized by category (infrastructure, core, apps)
   - `local.next_available_ip` - calculates next free IP in 150-199 range
   - `local.next_available_ip_cidr` - ready-to-use format for lxc-base module
   - `local.ip_cidr` - helper map for quick CIDR lookups
   - Symlinked to all apps in `tofu/apps/*/`

2. **[scripts/ip/next.sh](scripts/ip/next.sh)** - Shows next available IP
3. **[scripts/ip/list.sh](scripts/ip/list.sh)** - Lists all allocated IPs

### Task Commands

```bash
task ip:next   # Get next available IP (currently 192.168.1.150)
task ip:list   # Show all allocated IPs by category
```

### IP Range Strategy

| Range | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| 192.168.1.1-99 | Infrastructure |
| 192.168.1.100-149 | Core services |
| **192.168.1.150-199** | LXC apps (new deployments go here) |
| 192.168.1.200-224 | Reserved/manual |
| 192.168.1.225-254 | Special services |

### When Deploying a New Service

1. Run `task ip:next` to get the next IP
2. Add entry to `tofu/ip-registry.tf` in the `apps` section
3. Use `ip_address = "192.168.1.X/24"` in your lxc-base module
what did you say earlier about running a different bridge on proxmox that will run the 10.x IPs?

Earlier I mentioned that one option for expanding your IP space would be to create a separate network bridge on Proxmox (like `vmbr1`) that runs a different subnet (e.g., `10.0.0.0/16`). This would give you thousands of IPs for internal services.

However, I also pointed out the challenges with your setup:

1. **Your Verizon FIOS router** - Consumer routers typically can't route between multiple subnets or run multiple DHCP pools
2. **No DHCP server for 10.x** - You'd need something like your AdGuard/Unbound LXC or a dedicated DHCP server to hand out IPs on the 10.x network
3. **Routing between subnets** - Containers on 10.x wouldn't be able to reach your router/internet without NAT or a router that understands both networks

The simpler approach we went with was **static IP management** within your existing 192.168.1.0/24 network, which:
- Works with your current router
- Gives you ~50 IPs in the 150-199 range for apps
- Avoids complexity of multi-subnet routing

If you do want to explore the 10.x bridge approach in the future, the basic steps would be:

1. Create `vmbr1` on Proxmox with a 10.x.x.x IP
2. Set up DHCP/DNS on that bridge (could use your network-services LXC)
3. Configure NAT on Proxmox so 10.x can reach internet via 192.168.1.x
4. Connect internal-only services to `vmbr1`

But for now, with the IP registry tracking 192.168.1.150-199 for apps, you have 50 slots which should last a while. Want me to explore the multi-bridge setup, or is the current solution sufficient for your needs?
since proxmox is running on 1 node for now, if it goes down, the dhcp will be lost, but so will all of the services. So i think its not that unsafe for my setup to do this

That's a good point - since everything runs on a single Proxmox node anyway, if Proxmox goes down, both your services AND any DHCP server on it would be down together. There's no additional single point of failure risk.

So the architecture would be:

1. **`vmbr0`** (existing) - 192.168.1.0/24 - connected to your FIOS router, gets internet

- NAT on Proxmox forwards 10.x traffic to internet via vmbr0

- Internal-only apps that only need Traefik to proxy to them

2. Request hits Traefik (192.168.1.162 on vmbr0)

Exactly! That's the key piece.

If you configure your router to use AdGuard (192.168.1.196) as the DNS server for all DHCP clients, then:

1. **All devices on your LAN** (phones, laptops, TVs) get DNS from AdGuard
2. **AdGuard resolves internal domains** like `jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev` → `192.168.1.162` (Traefik)
3. **Everything flows through Traefik**, which then proxies to the backend services on 10.x

**Traffic flow:**
```
Device (192.168.1.x)
  ↓ DNS query: jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev
AdGuard (192.168.1.196)
  ↓ Returns: 192.168.1.162
Device connects to 192.168.1.162 (Traefik)
  ↓ Traefik proxies to backend
Jellyfin (10.0.0.50)
```

**This means:**
- ✅ All services can be on 10.x (except Traefik and AdGuard)
- ✅ LAN devices access everything via domain names
- ✅ No need for devices to know about 10.x network
- ✅ Works for DLNA/apps as long as they use DNS (most do)

**Router DNS configuration:**
You'd set your Verizon FIOS router's DHCP settings to hand out:
- Primary DNS: `192.168.1.196` (AdGuard)
- Secondary DNS: `1.1.1.1` (fallback if AdGuard is down)

Good question! IPv6 adds another layer to consider.

**Current status:**
- Your Verizon FIOS router likely supports IPv6 and may already be handing out IPv6 addresses via SLAAC (Stateless Address Autoconfiguration)
- Proxmox and LXC containers can get IPv6 addresses automatically
- If enabled, devices get both IPv4 (192.168.1.x) and IPv6 (fe80::/10 link-local + global prefix from ISP)

**With the 10.x internal network:**

**Option 1: IPv6 everywhere (recommended)**
- vmbr0: Has IPv6 from your ISP (e.g., 2600:xxxx:xxxx::/64)
- vmbr1: Use IPv6 ULA (Unique Local Address) like `fd00::/8`
  - Similar to 10.x in IPv4, but with IPv6
  - Example: `fd12:3456:7890::/48`
- Traefik gets both IPv4 + IPv6 on vmbr0
- Internal services get IPv6 ULA on vmbr1
- NAT66 or routing for internal network to reach internet

**Option 2: IPv4-only internal network**
- vmbr1 stays 10.x (IPv4 only)
- vmbr0 has IPv6
- Simpler, but wastes the IPv6 space

**Option 3: Dual-stack everywhere**
- Both networks get IPv4 + IPv6
- Most future-proof but more complex

**For your setup, I'd recommend:**
- **vmbr0**: Dual-stack (IPv4: 192.168.1.x, IPv6: from ISP)
- **vmbr1**: IPv4-only for now (10.0.0.0/16)
  - Simpler to manage
  - IPv6 ULA can be added later if needed
  - Most services don't need IPv6 internally

**IPv6 doesn't really solve your IP exhaustion problem** since you still have the IPv4 constraint, and most importantly, you want to keep things simple for now.

with this, if I want to have access to the 10.x IPs, the only way possible would be to add tailscale inside that network right?

Not necessarily! You have a few options to access the 10.x network from outside Proxmox:

**Option 1: Just use domain names (simplest)**
- You never need to access 10.x IPs directly
- Always go through Traefik: `https://jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Traefik handles routing to 10.x backends
- This is the cleanest approach for most use cases

**Option 2: VPN into the 10.x network**
- Run Tailscale on Proxmox itself (not just in containers)
- Advertise the 10.x subnet as a Tailscale route
- Then you can SSH/access 10.x IPs directly from anywhere
- Command: `tailscale up --advertise-routes=10.0.0.0/16`

**Option 3: SSH tunnel through Proxmox**
- SSH to Proxmox, then SSH to 10.x containers from there
- `ssh root@homelab` → `ssh root@10.0.0.50`
- No additional setup needed

**Option 4: Give your laptop dual-NIC (if physically on LAN)**
- Connect to a second interface on Proxmox that's on vmbr1
- Only works if physically connected, not practical

**Option 5: Route from your router (if router supports it)**
- Add static route: "10.0.0.0/16 via 192.168.1.215"
- Verizon FIOS routers likely don't support this

**My recommendation:**
- **Normal access**: Use domain names through Traefik (Option 1)
- **Admin/debugging**: SSH through Proxmox (Option 3)
- **Remote admin**: Tailscale on Proxmox advertising 10.x subnet (Option 2)

The beauty of this setup is that for 99% of use cases, you'll never need direct 10.x access. Everything goes through Traefik with proper domain names.

## Recommended Order: Provider Migration First

**Why this order:**

1. **Less moving parts** - Change one thing at a time

   - Adding network changes on top makes debugging harder

2. **Current setup works** - You have static IPs on 192.168.1.x that are stable
   - No urgent need to switch networks
   - You have 50 IPs available (150-199 range)

3. **Provider migration benefits everyone** - Even services staying on 192.168.1.x
   - Cleaner state management
   - Better file-sync with the new provider
   - Easier to manage going forward

4. **Network changes are easier after** - Once providers are clean:
   - Just update `bridge = "vmbr1"` in lxc-base
   - Change IP addresses in ip-registry.tf
   - No state surgery needed

**The plan:**

### Phase 1: Provider Migration (now)
- Migrate all apps to use the new filesync provider
- Remove old provisioner-based file syncing
- Clean up state files
- Test that everything still works on 192.168.1.x

### Phase 2: Network Setup (after migration stable)
- Create vmbr1 bridge on Proxmox
- Set up NAT/routing
- Update lxc-base module to support bridge selection
- Add 10.x range to ip-registry.tf

### Phase 3: Gradual Network Migration (app by app)
- Start with non-critical apps (test on 10.x)
- Move most services to 10.x
- Keep Traefik + AdGuard on 192.168.1.x

**Alternative (if you want both now):**
We could do them together, but it means:
- More variables changing at once

3. **Phase 3**: Gradually move apps to 10.x (update IP registry + module configs)

description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

variable "unprivileged" {
  description = "Run as unprivileged container"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged

  # Enable nesting for Docker
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  template = var.lxc_template

  tags = ["opentofu", "traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install Docker
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "install_docker" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg",
      "install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings",
      "rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --batch --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg",
      "echo \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian $(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME) stable\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list",
      "apt-get update",
      "apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin",
      "systemctl enable docker",
      "systemctl start docker",
      "mkdir -p /config/static /config/dynamic /config/certs /config/logs"
    ]

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  ip_address = "192.168.1.213/24"

# =============================================================================
# File Sync Module
# =============================================================================
# Reusable module for syncing files/directories to remote hosts via SSH.
# Handles ownership issues properly by using rsync with --no-owner --no-group
# and optionally setting ownership after sync.
#
# Usage:
#   module "sync_config" {
#     source = "../modules/file-sync"
#
#     source_dir           = "${path.module}/deploy"
#     target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
#     target_path          = "/config"
#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
#
#     # Optional: set ownership after sync
#     owner = "traefik"
#     group = "traefik"
#
#     # Optional: set permissions on specific files
#     file_permissions = {
#       "/config/certs/acme.json" = "600"
#       "/config/.env"            = "600"
#     }
#   }
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = "~> 3.2"
    }
  }
}

# Calculate hash of all files in source directory for change detection
locals {
  # Get all files in source directory
  source_files = var.source_dir != "" ? fileset(var.source_dir, "**") : []

  # Calculate combined hash of all files
  content_hash = var.source_dir != "" && length(local.source_files) > 0 ? sha256(join("", [
    for f in local.source_files : filemd5("${var.source_dir}/${f}")
  ])) : "empty"

  # Build chown command if owner/group specified
  chown_command = var.owner != "" ? (
    var.group != "" ? "chown -R ${var.owner}:${var.group} ${var.target_path}" : "chown -R ${var.owner} ${var.target_path}"
  ) : ""

  # Build chmod commands for specific file permissions
  chmod_commands = [
    for path, mode in var.file_permissions : "chmod ${mode} ${path} 2>/dev/null || true"
  ]

  # Combine post-sync commands
  post_sync_commands = compact(concat(
    [local.chown_command],
    local.chmod_commands,
    var.post_sync_commands
  ))
}

# Sync files to target with retry logic and verification
resource "null_resource" "sync" {
  count = var.source_dir != "" ? 1 : 0

  triggers = {
    content_hash     = local.content_hash
    target_host      = var.target_host
    target_path      = var.target_path
    owner            = var.owner
    group            = var.group
    file_permissions = jsonencode(var.file_permissions)
  }

  # Use rsync with retry logic, checksum verification, and proper error handling
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      set -e

      SSH_OPTS="-i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10"
      MAX_RETRIES=3
      RETRY_DELAY=5

      # Retry loop for rsync
      for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
        echo "rsync attempt $attempt/$MAX_RETRIES..."

        if rsync -avz --checksum ${var.delete_extra ? "--delete" : ""} --no-owner --no-group \
          -e "ssh $SSH_OPTS" \
          ${var.source_dir}/ \
          root@${var.target_host}:${var.target_path}/; then
          echo "rsync completed successfully"
          break
        fi

        if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: rsync failed after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "rsync failed, retrying in $RETRY_DELAY seconds..."
        sleep $RETRY_DELAY
      done

      # Verify sync by checking file count matches
      LOCAL_COUNT=$(find ${var.source_dir} -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      REMOTE_COUNT=$(ssh $SSH_OPTS root@${var.target_host} "find ${var.target_path} -type f | wc -l" | tr -d ' ')

      echo "Verification: Local files=$LOCAL_COUNT, Remote files=$REMOTE_COUNT"

      if [ "$LOCAL_COUNT" != "$REMOTE_COUNT" ]; then
        echo "WARNING: File count mismatch (local=$LOCAL_COUNT, remote=$REMOTE_COUNT)"
        echo "This may be expected if delete_extra=false and remote has additional files"
      fi

      echo "File sync completed and verified"
    EOF
  }
}

# Separate resource for post-sync commands to ensure proper execution
resource "null_resource" "post_sync" {
  count = var.source_dir != "" && length(local.post_sync_commands) > 0 ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [null_resource.sync]

  triggers = {
    sync_id          = null_resource.sync[0].id
    owner            = var.owner
    group            = var.group
    file_permissions = jsonencode(var.file_permissions)
    post_commands    = jsonencode(var.post_sync_commands)
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = var.target_host
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = local.post_sync_commands
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (using Docker-ready template):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (via lxc-base module)
#   2. Wait for SSH
#   3. Docker Compose deployment (remotedockercompose provider)
#
# No Docker installation step - template already has it!
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Static IP - avoids "pending" IP issues after container restart
  ip_address = "192.168.1.213/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Use privileged container for full Docker compatibility
  # (unprivileged containers can't run all Docker images due to sysctl restrictions)
  unprivileged = false

  # SSH to Proxmox host for configuring features (keyctl requires root@pam)
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for SSH
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "wait_for_ssh" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOF
      echo "Waiting for SSH on ${module.lxc.ip_address}..."
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if ssh -i ${var.ssh_private_key_path} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@${module.lxc.ip_address} 'echo SSH ready' 2>/dev/null; then
          exit 0
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
      exit 1
    EOF
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create /config directory
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "null_resource" "setup_config_dir" {
  depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_ssh]

  triggers = {
    container_id = module.lxc.container_id
  }

  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    host        = module.lxc.ip_address
    user        = "root"
    private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    timeout     = "2m"
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "mkdir -p /config",
      "systemctl start docker"
    ]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote-docker-compose-file_stack" "n8n" {
  provider   = remotedockercompose
  depends_on = [null_resource.setup_config_dir]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

content.text:
Since n8n only has a docker-compose.yml file and no other configs, the `remote-docker-compose-file` provider handles it all. We don't actually need file-sync for n8n!

Let me revert to a simpler approach - just remove the old provisioners and use the remote-docker-compose-file provider directly:

input.old_string:
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "file_sync" {
  source = "../../modules/file-sync"

  source_dir           = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = "/config"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ensure Docker is running before deploying compose
  post_sync_commands = [
    "systemctl start docker || true",
    "systemctl enable docker || true"
  ]

  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remotedockercompose_stack" "n8n" {
  provider   = remotedockercompose
  depends_on = [module.file_sync]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file into one module.
#
# This is the gold standard pattern for all Docker app deployments.
#
# Usage:
#   module "my_app" {
#     source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
#
#     # Identity
#     name         = "my-app"
#     container_id = 100
#
#     # Network
#     ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
#     gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
#
#     # Resources
#     cores  = 2
#     memory = 2048
#
#     # Deployment
#     deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
#
#     # SSH
#     ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
#   }
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source = "bpg/proxmox"
    }
    null = {
      source = "hashicorp/null"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = var.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Network
  ip_address = var.ip_address
  gateway    = var.gateway

  # Docker-ready template
  template = var.template

  # Container security
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # SSH to Proxmox for privileged container features
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  tags = concat(["opentofu", "docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only created if deploy_dir is provided

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ensure Docker is running
  post_sync_commands = concat([
    "systemctl start docker || true",
    "systemctl enable docker || true"
  ], var.post_sync_commands)

  # Set ownership if specified
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions

  delete_extra = var.delete_extra_files

  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
  depends_on = concat(
    [module.lxc],
    var.deploy_dir != "" ? [module.file_sync[0]] : []
  )

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = var.docker_compose_up
  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes (Optional)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  count  = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? 1 : 0
  source = "../proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
  description  = var.service_description

  urls = var.service_urls

  services = var.services

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = var.custom_notes
}

# Docker LXC Module

Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers on Proxmox.

## Features

- **All-in-one**: Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file
- **Docker-ready**: Uses pre-built Docker template for instant deployment
- **Declarative**: No manual provisioners or SSH connections
- **Flexible**: Supports privileged/unprivileged, custom resources, file permissions
- **Documented**: Automatic Proxmox notes generation

## Usage

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "my-app"
  container_id = 150

  # Network
  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"

  # Resources
  cores  = 2
  memory = 2048

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "My application"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
  }
}
```

## Requirements

- Deploy directory must contain `docker-compose.yml`
- Docker-ready LXC template (default: debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst)
- SSH access to Proxmox host (for privileged container features)

## Directory Structure

```
tofu/apps/my-app/
├── main.tf              # Module usage
├── deploy/
│   ├── docker-compose.yml  # Required
│   ├── .env                # Optional
│   └── config/             # Optional additional configs
```

## Outputs

- `container_id` - Proxmox container ID
- `ip_address` - Container IP address
- `ssh_command` - SSH command string
- `mac_address` - Container MAC address
- `lxc_module` - The underlying lxc-base module

## Examples

See `tofu/apps/n8n/` for a reference implementation.

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Architecture (Gold Standard Pattern):
#   1. LXC container with Docker pre-installed (lxc-base + Docker template)
#   2. Config files synced via file-sync module
#   3. Docker Compose managed by remotedockercompose provider
#
# This is the reference implementation for all future app deployments.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 502
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Static IP - avoids "pending" IP issues after container restart
  ip_address = "192.168.1.213/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Use privileged container for full Docker compatibility
  # (unprivileged containers can't run all Docker images due to sysctl restrictions)
  unprivileged = false

  # SSH to Proxmox host for configuring features (keyctl requires root@pam)
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  tags = ["opentofu", "n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The remotedockercompose provider handles:
#   - Transferring docker-compose.yml to /config/
#   - Running docker compose up
#   - Validating the deployment

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "n8n" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "/config/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/deploy/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = true
  validate = true
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  source = "../../modules/proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = "homelab"
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = "n8n"
  description  = "Workflow automation platform"

  urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.lxc.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${module.lxc.ip_address}"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${module.lxc.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for n8n LXC"

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container (using Docker-ready template)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Static IP - avoids "pending" IP issues after container restart
  ip_address = "192.168.1.213/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Docker already installed in template
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # Use Docker-ready template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Use privileged container for full Docker compatibility

  unprivileged = false

  # Container security
  unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  # SSH to Proxmox for privileged container features
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  tags = concat(["opentofu", "docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Deploy Configuration Files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only created if deploy_dir is provided

module "file_sync" {
  count  = var.deploy_dir != "" ? 1 : 0
  source = "../file-sync"

  source_dir           = var.deploy_dir
  target_host          = module.lxc.ip_address
  target_path          = var.target_path
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Ensure Docker is running
  post_sync_commands = concat([
    "systemctl start docker || true",
    "systemctl enable docker || true"
  ], var.post_sync_commands)

  # Set ownership if specified
  owner = var.config_owner
  group = var.config_group

  # File permissions
  file_permissions = var.file_permissions

  delete_extra = var.delete_extra_files

  depends_on_resources = [module.lxc]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Stack
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "remote_docker_compose_file_stack" "app" {
  # depends_on must be static, so we always include both
  depends_on = [
    module.lxc,
    module.file_sync
  ]

  host        = module.lxc.ip_address
  remote_path = "${var.target_path}/docker-compose.yml"
  content     = file("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")

  up       = var.docker_compose_up
  validate = var.docker_compose_validate
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Proxmox Notes (Optional)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "proxmox_notes" {
  count  = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? 1 : 0
  source = "../proxmox-notes"

  container_id         = var.container_id
  proxmox_host         = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
  description  = var.service_description

  urls = var.service_urls

  services = var.services

  ssh_host = module.lxc.ip_address

  custom_notes = var.custom_notes
}
