# Migration Guide: Docker-LXC Module Pattern

This guide documents the standard pattern for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers using pure OpenTofu (no manual provisioners).

## Overview

The **docker-lxc module** is the gold standard for all Docker app deployments. It provides:

- LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
- File synchronization via rsync (file-sync module)
- Docker Compose stack deployment
- Automatic Proxmox notes generation
- Consistent, declarative infrastructure

## Module Architecture

```
docker-lxc module
├── lxc-base module          # Container creation & configuration
├── file-sync module         # Rsync-based file transfer
└── remote-docker-compose    # Docker Compose deployment
```

## Standard Deployment Pattern

### Directory Structure

```
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf              # Module invocation
├── notes.md             # Custom documentation (optional)
├── ip-registry.tf       # IP allocation (symlinked from tofu/)
├── shared.tf            # Common variables (symlinked from tofu/)
├── versions.tf          # Provider config (symlinked from tofu/)
└── deploy/
    ├── docker-compose.yml
    ├── .env.tpl         # Template for secrets (if needed)
    ├── .env.example     # Documentation
    └── config/          # App configuration files
```

### Basic main.tf Template

```hcl
# =============================================================================
# MyApp LXC - Brief Description
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: XXX
# IP: 192.168.1.XXX

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables (optional - customize resources)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for MyApp LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = XXX
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MyApp Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "myapp"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.myapp}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory

  # Privileged container if binding to ports < 1024
  unprivileged = false  # or true for most apps

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "MyApp"
  service_description = "Brief description of what this app does"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://myapp.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main web interface" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["myapp", "category"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.myapp.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.myapp.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.myapp.ssh_command
}
```

## Secret Management Pattern

For apps requiring secrets (API keys, passwords, etc.), use the **local_sensitive_file + filesync_file** pattern:

### 1. Create .env.tpl Template

```bash
# deploy/.env.tpl
API_KEY=${api_key}
DATABASE_PASSWORD=${db_password}
```

### 2. Add Secret Resources to main.tf

```hcl
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Secret Management
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "myapp_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    api_key     = local.op.myapp_api_key
    db_password = local.op.myapp_db_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/myapp.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "myapp_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.myapp_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.ip_registry.apps.myapp

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.myapp]
}
```

### 3. Add .terraform/ to .gitignore

```bash
echo ".terraform/" >> .gitignore
```

### 4. Create .env.example

```bash
# deploy/.env.example
# Example environment variables for MyApp
# The actual .env file is generated by OpenTofu from .env.tpl
# using secrets from 1Password

API_KEY=your_api_key_here
DATABASE_PASSWORD=your_password_here
```

### 5. Add Secrets to 1Password

1. Create item in `homelab` vault
2. Add to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

```hcl
data "onepassword_item" "myapp" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "myapp"
}

# In locals.op map:
op = {
  # ... existing secrets ...
  myapp_api_key     = data.onepassword_item.myapp.password
  myapp_db_password = lookup(local._myapp_fields, "db_password", "")
}
```

## Migration Checklist

### Pre-Migration

- [ ] Backup any important data from existing deployment
- [ ] Document current configuration
- [ ] Get next available IP: `task ip:next`
- [ ] Add IP to `tofu/ip-registry.tf`

### Migration Steps

1. **Create app directory structure**
   ```bash
   mkdir -p tofu/apps/myapp/deploy
   cd tofu/apps/myapp
   ln -s ../../shared.tf .
   ln -s ../../versions.tf .
   ln -s ../../ip-registry.tf .
   ```

2. **Copy deployment files**
   ```bash
   # Copy docker-compose.yml and configs to deploy/
   cp /path/to/docker-compose.yml deploy/
   ```

# Migration Guide: Docker-LXC Module Pattern

This guide documents the standard pattern for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers using pure OpenTofu (no manual provisioners).

## Overview

The **docker-lxc module** is the gold standard for all Docker app deployments. It provides:

- LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
- File synchronization via rsync (file-sync module)
- Docker Compose stack deployment
- Automatic Proxmox notes generation
- Consistent, declarative infrastructure

## Module Architecture

```
docker-lxc module
├── lxc-base module          # Container creation & configuration
├── file-sync module         # Rsync-based file transfer
└── remote-docker-compose    # Docker Compose deployment
```

## Standard Deployment Pattern

### Directory Structure

```
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf              # Module invocation
├── notes.md             # Custom documentation (optional)
├── ip-registry.tf       # IP allocation (symlinked from tofu/)
├── shared.tf            # Common variables (symlinked from tofu/)
├── versions.tf          # Provider config (symlinked from tofu/)
└── deploy/
    ├── docker-compose.yml
    ├── .env.tpl         # Template for secrets (if needed)
    ├── .env.example     # Documentation
    └── config/          # App configuration files
```

### Basic main.tf Template

```hcl
# =============================================================================
# MyApp LXC - Brief Description
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: XXX
# IP: 192.168.1.XXX

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables (optional - customize resources)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for MyApp LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = XXX
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MyApp Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "myapp"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network
  ip_address = "${local.ip_registry.apps.myapp}/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory

  # Privileged container if binding to ports < 1024
  unprivileged = false  # or true for most apps

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "MyApp"
  service_description = "Brief description of what this app does"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://myapp.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main web interface" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["myapp", "category"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.myapp.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.myapp.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.myapp.ssh_command
}
```

## Secret Management Pattern

For apps requiring secrets (API keys, passwords, etc.), use the **local_sensitive_file + filesync_file** pattern:

### 1. Create .env.tpl Template

```bash
# deploy/.env.tpl
API_KEY=${api_key}
DATABASE_PASSWORD=${db_password}
```

### 2. Add Secret Resources to main.tf

```hcl
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Secret Management
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "myapp_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    api_key     = local.op.myapp_api_key
    db_password = local.op.myapp_db_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/myapp.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "myapp_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.myapp_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.ip_registry.apps.myapp

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.myapp]
}
```

### 3. Add .terraform/ to .gitignore

```bash
echo ".terraform/" >> .gitignore
```

### 4. Create .env.example

```bash
# deploy/.env.example
# Example environment variables for MyApp
# The actual .env file is generated by OpenTofu from .env.tpl
# using secrets from 1Password

API_KEY=your_api_key_here
DATABASE_PASSWORD=your_password_here
```

### 5. Add Secrets to 1Password

1. Create item in `homelab` vault
2. Add to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

```hcl
data "onepassword_item" "myapp" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "myapp"
}

# In locals.op map:
op = {
  # ... existing secrets ...
  myapp_api_key     = data.onepassword_item.myapp.password
  myapp_db_password = lookup(local._myapp_fields, "db_password", "")
}
```

## Migration Checklist

### Pre-Migration

- [ ] Backup any important data from existing deployment
- [ ] Document current configuration
- [ ] Get next available IP: `task ip:next`
- [ ] Add IP to `tofu/ip-registry.tf`

### Migration Steps

1. **Create app directory structure**
   ```bash
   mkdir -p tofu/apps/myapp/deploy
   cd tofu/apps/myapp
   ln -s ../../shared.tf .
   ln -s ../../versions.tf .
   ln -s ../../ip-registry.tf .
   ```

2. **Copy deployment files**
   ```bash
   # Copy docker-compose.yml and configs to deploy/
   cp /path/to/docker-compose.yml deploy/
   cp -r /path/to/configs deploy/
   ```

3. **Create main.tf using template above**

4. **Add secrets if needed** (follow Secret Management Pattern)

5. **Create notes.md** (optional)
   ```markdown
   ## Quick Commands

   **View logs:**
   ```
   docker compose logs -f
   ```

   **Restart service:**
   ```
   docker compose restart
   ```
   ```

6. **Initialize and plan**
   ```bash
   task tofu:init APP=myapp
   task tofu:plan APP=myapp
   ```

7. **Apply**
   ```bash
   task tofu:apply APP=myapp
   ```

8. **Verify**
   ```bash
   task tofu:ssh APP=myapp
   docker ps
   curl https://myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ```

### Post-Migration

- [ ] Test application functionality
- [ ] Update monitoring/backups if needed
- [ ] Document any app-specific quirks in notes.md
- [ ] Remove old deployment (if replacing existing)

## Benefits Over Manual Deployments

### Before (Manual/Mixed Approach)

- Mix of Terraform resources and null_resource provisioners
- Manual SSH commands in remote-exec blocks
- Difficult to track state and detect drift
- Inconsistent patterns across apps
- Hard to maintain and debug

### After (docker-lxc Module)

- Consistent pattern across all apps
- Proper state management and drift detection
- Automatic documentation via Proxmox notes

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider (`1password/onepassword`).

### Key Files

- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

```hcl
local.op.cloudflare_api_token    # Cloudflare DNS/tunnel API
local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

   ```hcl

     vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
     title = "myservice"
   }
   ```

3. Add to `local.op` map in same file:

   ```hcl

     myservice_password = data.onepassword_item.myservice.password
     # For section fields, flatten first then lookup:
     myservice_api_key = lookup(local._myservice_fields, "api_key", "")
   }
   ```

4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Field Access Patterns

```hcl
# Main password field
data.onepassword_item.myitem.password

# Credential field (API keys)
data.onepassword_item.myitem.credential

# Custom fields in sections (must flatten):
locals {
  _myitem_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.myitem.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)
}
# Then: lookup(local._myitem_fields, "field_label", "")
```

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml

  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

| `Cloudflare` | tunnel_token, ddns_api_token (sections) |

input.content:
# Docker LXC Module

Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers. This is the **gold standard pattern** for all Docker app deployments in the homelab.

## What It Does

This module combines multiple lower-level modules into one cohesive deployment:

1. **LXC Container** (via `lxc-base` module)
   - Creates Proxmox LXC container with Docker pre-installed
   - Configures networking (static IP)
   - Sets up SSH access
   - Configures container features (nesting, keyctl for Docker)

2. **File Synchronization** (via `file-sync` module)
   - Uses rsync to sync `deploy/` directory to container
   - Maintains file permissions and ownership
   - Verifies sync completed successfully
   - Runs post-sync commands (enables Docker service)

3. **Docker Compose Deployment** (via `remote-docker-compose-file` provider)
   - Deploys docker-compose.yml to container
   - Runs `docker compose up` automatically
   - Validates compose file syntax

4. **Proxmox Notes Generation**
   - Automatically generates rich markdown notes in Proxmox UI
   - Includes service URLs, ports, SSH command, custom notes
   - Makes container documentation accessible from Proxmox

## Quick Start

```hcl
module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "myapp"
  container_id = 150

  # Network
  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
  gateway    = "192.168.1.1"

  # Resources
  cores  = 2
  memory = 2048

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Documentation
  service_name        = "MyApp"
  service_description = "What this app does"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main interface" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["myapp", "category"]
}
```

## Required Directory Structure

```
your-app/
├── main.tf              # Module invocation
├── notes.md             # Custom notes (optional)
└── deploy/
    ├── docker-compose.yml  # Required
    └── config/             # Optional app configs
```

## Variables

### Required

- `name` - Container hostname
- `container_id` - Proxmox container ID (unique)
- `ip_address` - Static IP with CIDR (e.g., "192.168.1.150/24")
- `deploy_dir` - Path to deployment files directory
- `ssh_private_key_path` - SSH key for container access

### Optional (with sensible defaults)

- `cores` - CPU cores (default: 2)
- `memory` - RAM in MB (default: 2048)
- `swap` - Swap in MB (default: 1024)
- `rootfs_size` - Disk size in GB (default: 8)
- `unprivileged` - Run as unprivileged container (default: false)
- `gateway` - Network gateway (default: "192.168.1.1")
- `target_path` - Where files are synced on container (default: "/config")

See [variables.tf](./variables.tf) for complete list.

## Outputs

- `container_id` - The Proxmox container ID
- `ip_address` - The container's IP address
- `ssh_command` - SSH command to connect to container

## Secret Management

For apps requiring secrets, use the `local_sensitive_file` + `filesync_file` pattern:

```hcl
# Create local file from template with secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "myapp_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    api_key = local.op.myapp_api_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/myapp.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Sync to container
resource "filesync_file" "myapp_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.myapp_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.myapp.ip_address
  mode        = "0600"
  depends_on  = [module.myapp]
}
```

See [Traefik example](../../apps/traefik/main.tf) for complete implementation.

## Privileged vs Unprivileged

### Use Privileged (`unprivileged = false`) when:
- Binding to ports < 1024 (e.g., 80, 443)
- Requiring special kernel features
- Docker needs full capabilities

Examples: Traefik, network services

### Use Unprivileged (`unprivileged = true`) when:
- Standard web applications
- API services
- Most Docker applications
- Better security isolation needed

Examples: Dashboards, monitoring, most apps

## Examples

- **Simple**: [portainer](../../apps/portainer/main.tf) - Minimal configuration
- **With secrets**: [traefik](../../apps/traefik/main.tf) - Secret management
- **Complex**: [monitoring](../../apps/monitoring/main.tf) - Multiple services

## Migration Guide

See [MIGRATION.md](../../MIGRATION.md) for complete guide on migrating existing apps to this pattern.

## Module Dependencies

This module requires:
- `lxc-base` module
- `file-sync` module
- `filesync` provider (for future secret files)
- `remote-docker-compose-file` provider

All dependencies are automatically handled when you use this module.

## Benefits

✅ **Consistent** - Same pattern across all apps
✅ **Declarative** - Pure OpenTofu, no shell scripts
✅ **Maintainable** - Easy to understand and modify
✅ **Documented** - Automatic Proxmox notes generation
✅ **Reliable** - Proper state management and drift detection
✅ **Testable** - Can plan before apply, validate locally

## Troubleshooting

### Container won't create
- Check if container ID is already in use
- Verify template exists: `ssh root@homelab pveam list local`
- Check IP isn't already allocated: `task ip:list`

### Files not syncing
- Verify `deploy/` directory exists and contains files
- Check SSH access to container: `ssh root@<ip>`
- Review rsync output in terraform logs

### Docker Compose fails
- Validate compose file locally: `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config`
- Check container has Docker running: `ssh root@<ip> systemctl status docker`
- Review compose logs: `ssh root@<ip> docker compose -f /config/docker-compose.yml logs`

## Architecture Diagram

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         docker-lxc module               │
│                                         │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  lxc-base                         │ │
│  │  • Container creation             │ │
│  │  • Network config                 │ │
│  │  • Docker template                │ │
│  └───────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                  │                      │
│  ┌───────────────▼───────────────────┐ │
│  │  file-sync                        │ │
│  │  • Rsync deploy/ → /config        │ │
│  │  • Verify file count              │ │
│  │  • Enable Docker service          │ │
│  └───────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                  │                      │
│  ┌───────────────▼───────────────────┐ │
│  │  remote-docker-compose-file       │ │
│  │  • Deploy compose to /config/     │ │
│  │  • Run docker compose up          │ │
│  │  • Validate syntax                │ │
│  └───────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                         │
│  • Auto-generate Proxmox notes         │
│  • Output connection info              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Version History

- **v1.0** - Initial release with lxc-base + file-sync + remote-docker-compose
- **Current** - Integrated Proxmox notes generation, moved from standalone module

---

For questions or issues, refer to examples in `tofu/apps/` or see the [Migration Guide](../../MIGRATION.md).

# Docker LXC Module

Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers on Proxmox.

## Features

- **All-in-one**: Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file
- **Docker-ready**: Uses pre-built Docker template for instant deployment
- **Declarative**: No manual provisioners or SSH connections
- **Flexible**: Supports privileged/unprivileged, custom resources, file permissions
- **Documented**: Automatic Proxmox notes generation

## Usage

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "my-app"
  container_id = 150

  # Network
  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"

  # Resources
  cores  = 2
  memory = 2048

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "My application"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
  }
}
```

## Requirements

- Deploy directory must contain `docker-compose.yml`
- Docker-ready LXC template (default: debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst)
- SSH access to Proxmox host (for privileged container features)

## Directory Structure

```
tofu/apps/my-app/
├── main.tf              # Module usage
├── deploy/
│   ├── docker-compose.yml  # Required
│   ├── .env                # Optional
│   └── config/             # Optional additional configs
```

## Outputs

- `container_id` - Proxmox container ID
- `ip_address` - Container IP address
- `ssh_command` - SSH command string
- `mac_address` - Container MAC address
- `lxc_module` - The underlying lxc-base module

## Examples

See `tofu/apps/n8n/` for a reference implementation.

## Secret Management Pattern

For applications that need secrets in environment files:

```hcl
# 1. Create template file
# deploy/.env.tpl
DB_PASSWORD=${db_password}
API_KEY=${api_key}

# 2. Generate local file with secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "app_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    db_password = local.op.postgres_password
    api_key     = local.op.api_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/app.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

# 3. Sync to container
resource "filesync_file" "app_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.app_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = "192.168.1.150"
  mode        = "0600"
  depends_on  = [module.my_app]
}
```

**Benefits:**
- Fully declarative (no null_resource)
- Proper state tracking
- Secrets never in git
- Template-based configuration

## Common Patterns

### Privileged Containers

For applications binding to privileged ports (80, 443):

```hcl
module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  unprivileged = false  # Required for ports < 1024
}
```

### File Permissions

For specific file permission requirements:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  file_permissions = {
    "/config/scripts/backup.sh" = "0755"
    "/config/certs/cert.pem"    = "0400"
  }
}
```

### Custom Post-Sync Commands

Run additional commands after file sync:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  post_sync_commands = [
    "chown -R 1000:1000 /config/data",
    "chmod +x /config/scripts/*.sh"
  ]
}
```

### Custom Notes

Add operational documentation to Proxmox UI:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.150:8080"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main application interface" },
    { name = "API", port = 3000, info = "REST API endpoint" }
  ]
}
```

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           docker-lxc Module                 │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │      lxc-base Module                 │  │
│  │  - Container creation                │  │
│  │  - Network configuration             │  │
│  │  - SSH key injection                 │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                    ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │      file-sync Module                │  │
│  │  - Rsync deploy/ directory           │  │
│  │  - Set ownership/permissions         │  │
│  │  - Run post-sync commands            │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                    ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  remote-docker-compose-file          │  │
│  │  - Validate docker-compose.yml       │  │
│  │  - Run docker compose up -d          │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                    ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │      proxmox-notes Module            │  │
│  │  - Generate formatted notes          │  │
│  │  - Update container description      │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Troubleshooting

### Docker compose fails to start

```bash
# SSH to container
ssh root@192.168.1.150

# Check Docker status
systemctl status docker

# Check compose file syntax
cd /config && docker compose config

# View logs
cd /config && docker compose logs
```

### File sync issues

```bash
# Verify files were synced
ssh root@192.168.1.150 ls -la /config

# Check permissions
ssh root@192.168.1.150 stat /config/.env

# Manual rsync test
rsync -avz deploy/ root@192.168.1.150:/config/
```

### Container won't start

```bash
# Check Proxmox logs
ssh root@homelab pct status 150

# Check container config
ssh root@homelab pct config 150

# Start manually
ssh root@homelab pct start 150
```

## Examples

### Reference Implementations

- **[tofu/apps/traefik/](../../apps/traefik/)** - Privileged container with secret management
- **[tofu/apps/n8n/](../../apps/n8n/)** - Standard unprivileged deployment
- **[tofu/apps/monitoring/](../../apps/monitoring/)** - Multi-service stack

### Full Example with All Features

See [MIGRATION.md](../../MIGRATION.md) for complete migration examples and patterns.

# Docker LXC Module

Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers on Proxmox.

## Features

- **All-in-one**: Combines lxc-base, file-sync, and remote-docker-compose-file
- **Docker-ready**: Uses pre-built Docker template for instant deployment
- **Declarative**: No manual provisioners or SSH connections
- **Flexible**: Supports privileged/unprivileged, custom resources, file permissions
- **Documented**: Automatic Proxmox notes generation

## Usage

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "my-app"
  container_id = 150

  # Network
  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"

  # Resources
  cores  = 2
  memory = 2048

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "My application"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
  }
}
```

## Requirements

- Deploy directory must contain `docker-compose.yml`
- Docker-ready LXC template (default: debian-13-docker_1.0_amd64.tar.zst)
- SSH access to Proxmox host (for privileged container features)

## Directory Structure

```
tofu/apps/my-app/
├── main.tf              # Module usage
├── deploy/
│   ├── docker-compose.yml  # Required
│   ├── .env                # Optional
│   └── config/             # Optional additional configs
```

## Outputs

- `container_id` - Proxmox container ID
- `ip_address` - Container IP address
- `ssh_command` - SSH command string
- `mac_address` - Container MAC address
- `lxc_module` - The underlying lxc-base module

## Secret Management Pattern

For applications that need secrets in environment files:

```hcl
# 1. Create template file
# deploy/.env.tpl
DB_PASSWORD=${db_password}
API_KEY=${api_key}

# 2. Generate local file with secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "app_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    db_password = local.op.postgres_password
    api_key     = local.op.api_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/app.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

# 3. Sync to container
resource "filesync_file" "app_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.app_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = "192.168.1.150"
  mode        = "0600"
  depends_on  = [module.my_app]
}
```

**Benefits:**
- Fully declarative (no null_resource)
- Proper state tracking
- Secrets never in git
- Template-based configuration

## Common Patterns

### Privileged Containers

For applications binding to privileged ports (80, 443):

```hcl
module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  unprivileged = false  # Required for ports < 1024
}
```

### File Permissions

For specific file permission requirements:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  file_permissions = {
    "/config/scripts/backup.sh" = "0755"
    "/config/certs/cert.pem"    = "0400"
  }
}
```

### Custom Post-Sync Commands

Run additional commands after file sync:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  post_sync_commands = [
    "chown -R 1000:1000 /config/data",
    "chmod +x /config/scripts/*.sh"
  ]
}
```

### Custom Notes

Add operational documentation to Proxmox UI:

```hcl
module "my_app" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
  # ...
  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://my-app.homelab.rambtech.dev/"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.150:8080"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Web UI", port = 8080, info = "Main application interface" },
    { name = "API", port = 3000, info = "REST API endpoint" }
  ]
}
```

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           docker-lxc Module                 │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │      lxc-base Module                 │  │
│  │  - Container creation                │  │
│  │  - Network configuration             │  │
│  │  - SSH key injection                 │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                    ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │      file-sync Module                │  │
│  │  - Rsync deploy/ directory           │  │
│  │  - Set ownership/permissions         │  │
│  │  - Run post-sync commands            │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                    ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  remote-docker-compose-file          │  │
│  │  - Validate docker-compose.yml       │  │
│  │  - Run docker compose up -d          │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                    ▼                        │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │      proxmox-notes Module            │  │
│  │  - Generate formatted notes          │  │
│  │  - Update container description      │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
